name: Acid Splash

summary.upcast: 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 11, 4d6 at level 17

description: You hurl a bubble of acid at 1 creature within 60 ft, or at 2 creatures within 5 ft of each other. Each target makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 acid damage.
Damage rises to 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 11 and 4d6 at level 17.

name: Aid

m.text: Small strip of white cloth

description: Pick up to 3 creatures within 30 ft. For 8 hours, each one gains 5 hit points to its hit point maximum and 5 to its current hit points.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds another 5 hit points per target.

name: Alarm

m.text: tiny bell, fine silver wire

description: Ward a door, window or area up to a 20 ft cube within 30 ft for 8 hours. Whenever a Tiny or larger creature touches or enters it, you are alerted. You can name creatures that do not set it off.
Choose the alert type when casting. Mental: a ping in your mind, which wakes you, if you are within 1 mile. Audible: a hand-bell sound for 10 seconds, heard within 60 ft. Ritual.

name: Alter Self
description: You reshape yourself for up to 1 hour (concentration). Pick one option; as an action you can swap it for another.
Aquatic Adaptation: gills and webbed fingers. You breathe water and swim at your walking speed.
Change Appearance: choose your height, weight, face, voice, hair, even another race. Stats, size and body shape stay. Reshape again as an action.
Natural Weapons: claws, fangs or horns. Unarmed strikes deal 1d6 bludgeoning, piercing or slashing, count as magic, are proficient and get +1 to attack and damage.

name: Animal Friendship

m.text: a morsel of food

description: Pick a beast you can see within 30 ft; it must be able to see and hear you. If its Intelligence is 4 or higher, the spell fails. Otherwise it makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you for 24 hours.
The charm ends if you or your companions harm it.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 lets you affect 1 more beast.

name: Animal Messenger

m.text: Morsel of food

description: Pick a Tiny beast you can see within 30 ft. Name a place you have visited, describe a recipient, and give it a message of up to 25 words.

For the duration it travels there, about 50 miles per 24 hours if it flies or 25 miles if not, then repeats the message in your voice, only to someone matching your description. If it doesn't arrive in time, the message is lost and the beast heads back to you.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 48 hours to the duration.

name: Animate Dead

m.text: Drop of blood, bit of flesh, pinch of bone dust

description: You raise a pile of bones (skeleton) or a Small or Medium humanoid corpse (zombie) within 10 ft as your undead servant. The DM has its stats.

Bonus action on your turn: give any of your undead within 60 ft one shared order, either a move and action for its next turn or a standing task like guarding a hall. Unordered, it only defends itself.
Control lasts 24 hours. Recasting on up to 4 of them before then renews control instead of raising one more.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 raises or keeps 2 more undead, each from its own corpse or bone pile.

name: Animate Objects
description: Up to 10 unattended nonmagical objects within 120 ft become your constructs (Medium counts 2, Large 4, Huge 8, max). At 0 HP one reverts, carrying excess damage over.
Bonus action: command any within 500 ft (one order for all); otherwise they only defend. Slam: bludgeoning, 5 ft.
Con 10, Int 3, Wis 3, Cha 1, speed 30 (legless: fly 30, hover), blindsight 30.
Tiny: 20 HP, AC 18, +8, 1d4+4, Str 4, Dex 18.
Small: 25 HP, AC 16, +6, 1d8+2, Str 6, Dex 14.
Medium: 40 HP, AC 13, +5, 2d6+1, Str 10, Dex 12.
Large: 50 HP, AC 10, +6, 2d10+2, Str 14, Dex 10.
Huge: 80 HP, AC 10, +8, 2d12+4, Str 18, Dex 6.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 5 lets you animate 2 more objects.

name: Antilife Shell
description: A 10 ft barrier surrounds you and moves with you for up to 1 hour (concentration). Creatures other than undead and constructs can't pass through it or reach across it, though they can still cast spells and make ranged or reach-weapon attacks through it.
The spell ends if your own movement would push one of those creatures through the barrier.

name: Arcane Eye

m.text: A bit of bat fur

description: An invisible eye appears within 30 ft and hovers for up to 1 hour (concentration). You see what it sees, in every direction, with normal vision and darkvision to 30 ft.
Action: move the eye up to 30 ft. It can travel any distance from you but not to another plane. Solid barriers stop it, yet it slips through a gap 1 inch wide.

name: Arcane Gate
description: Pick two points on the ground you can see, one within 10 ft of you and one within 500 ft. A ring portal 10 ft across opens over each for up to 10 minutes (concentration). If a creature occupies either point, the spell fails and the slot is lost.
Each ring works from one side only (your choice); whatever enters exits the other ring as if they were adjacent. Mist in the rings blocks sight. Bonus action: turn the rings to face new directions.

name: Arcane Lock

m.text: Gold dust worth 25 gp, used up

description: Touch a closed entryway (door, window, gate, chest and the like) to lock it until dispelled. You and creatures you name when casting open it normally. You can set a password: speaking it within 5 ft suppresses the spell for 1 minute.
Anyone else finds it impassable until it is broken, dispelled or suppressed; knock suppresses it for 10 minutes. The DC to break it or pick its locks rises by 10.

name: Armor of Agathys

summary.upcast: +5 temporary hit points and +5 cold damage per slot level above 1

m.text: a cup of water

description: You gain 5 temporary hit points for 1 hour, wrapped in spectral frost. While any remain, a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 cold damage.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 5 temporary hit points and 5 cold damage.

name: Arms of Hadar
description: Dark tentacles erupt from you in a 10 ft radius. Each creature in the area makes a Strength save, taking 2d6 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.
A creature that fails also cannot take reactions until its next turn.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

name: Augury

m.text: Marked sticks, bones or similar tokens worth 25 gp

description: You consult a divining tool and get an omen from an otherworldly power about a specific plan you mean to carry out in the next 30 minutes. The DM gives one answer:
• Weal: good results.
• Woe: bad results.
• Weal and woe: both.
• Nothing: neither especially good nor bad.
It ignores later changes, such as new spells or a companion lost or gained. Each extra casting before your next long rest adds a cumulative 25% chance of a random reading, rolled secretly by the DM.

name: Aura of Life
description: For up to 10 minutes (concentration) a 30 ft aura moves with you. Nonhostile creatures in it, you included, resist necrotic damage and their hit point maximum can't be lowered.
A nonhostile living creature that starts its turn in the aura at 0 HP regains 1 HP.

name: Aura of Purity
description: For up to 10 minutes (concentration) a 30 ft aura moves with you. Nonhostile creatures in it, you included, can't be diseased, resist poison damage, and have advantage on saves against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned or stunned.

name: Aura of Vitality
description: A 30 ft radius aura of healing surrounds you and moves with you for up to 1 minute (concentration). As a bonus action on each of your turns, you can restore 2d6 hit points to one creature in the aura, including yourself.

name: Awaken

m.text: Agate worth 1,000 gp, used up

description: After 8 hours of work on a gem, you touch a beast or plant, Huge or smaller, with Intelligence 3 or less (or none). It gains Intelligence 10 and speaks one language you know. A plant can also move its limbs and gains human-like senses; the DM picks its stats.
It stays charmed by you for 30 days unless you or your allies harm it. Afterwards it chooses whether to stay friendly, based on how you treated it.

name: Bane

m.text: a drop of blood

description: Up to 3 creatures you can see within 30 ft each make a Charisma save. For the duration (concentration, 1 minute), each one that fails rolls a d4 whenever it makes an attack roll or saving throw, and lowers that result by the number rolled.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 target.

name: Banishing Smite
description: Your next weapon hit before the spell ends (concentration, up to 1 minute) deals an extra 5d10 force damage.

If that hit leaves the target at 50 HP or fewer, it is banished. A creature from another plane is sent home. One native to your plane goes to a harmless demiplane, incapacitated, and returns to its old space (or the nearest free one) when the spell ends.

name: Banishment

m.text: Something the target finds distasteful

description: One creature you can see within 60 ft makes a Charisma save or is banished for up to 1 minute (concentration).
Native to your plane: it waits, incapacitated, in a harmless demiplane, and returns to its space (or the nearest free one) when the spell ends.
From another plane: it is sent home. If the spell ends before 1 minute passes it comes back as above; if it lasts the full minute, it stays gone.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 4 adds one more target.

name: Barkskin

m.text: Handful of oak bark

description: You touch a willing creature. For up to 1 hour (concentration) its skin turns rough like bark, and its AC is never lower than 16, whatever armor it wears.

name: Beacon of Hope
description: Choose any number of creatures within 30 ft. For up to 1 minute (concentration), each has advantage on Wisdom saves and death saves, and any healing it receives restores the maximum possible hit points instead of rolling.

name: Beast Sense
description: Touch a willing beast. For up to 1 hour (concentration), spend your action to look and listen through it, using any special senses it has; another action brings you back.
Meanwhile you can't see or hear your own surroundings.

name: Bestow Curse
description: You touch a creature; it makes a Wisdom save or is cursed for up to 1 minute (concentration). Pick the curse when you cast:
• Disadvantage on ability checks and saves with one ability score you choose.
• Disadvantage on its attack rolls against you.
• Each time its turn begins, it makes a Wisdom save; failing wastes its action that turn.
• Your attacks and spells deal it an extra 1d8 necrotic damage.
Remove curse ends it. The DM may allow another curse of similar strength.
higherLevels: Slot 4: concentration, up to 10 minutes; slot 5: 8 hours; slot 7: 24 hours; slot 9: until dispelled (slot 5 or higher needs no concentration).

name: Bigby's Hand

m.text: An eggshell and a snakeskin glove

description: A Large force hand appears within 120 ft (concentration, 1 minute): AC 20, HP = your HP maximum, Str 26, Dex 10, not space-filling; 0 HP ends it. When cast and as a later bonus action, move it up to 60 ft, then:
Clenched Fist: melee spell attack vs a target within 5 ft of it; 4d8 force.
Forceful Hand: Strength contest vs its Athletics (advantage vs Medium or smaller); push 5 ft + 5 ft × spellcasting modifier.
Grasping Hand: grapple a Huge or smaller target, same advantage. While held, bonus action: crush, 2d6 + spellcasting modifier bludgeoning.
Interposing Hand: half cover for you vs one creature, which can pass only if its Strength tops 26 (as difficult terrain).
higherLevels: Each slot level above 5 adds 2d8 to the fist and 2d6 to the crush.

name: Blade Barrier
description: A wall of spinning magical blades appears within 90 ft for up to 10 minutes (concentration): straight, up to 100 ft long, or a ring up to 60 ft across; either way 20 ft high and 5 ft thick. It grants three-quarters cover, and its space is difficult terrain.
A creature that starts its turn in the wall, or enters it for the first time that turn, makes a Dexterity save: 6d10 slashing, half on a success.

name: Blade Ward
description: Until the end of your next turn, weapon attacks deal you only half their bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage (you have resistance to those types).

name: Bless

m.text: a sprinkling of holy water

description: Up to 3 creatures within 30 ft are blessed for 1 minute (concentration). Whenever a target attacks or saves, it can roll a d4 and add it to the result.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 target.

name: Blight
description: One creature you can see within 30 ft makes a Constitution save: 8d8 necrotic, half on a success. Undead and constructs are unaffected.
A plant creature or magical plant saves with disadvantage and takes maximum damage. An ordinary non-creature plant, like a tree or shrub, just withers and dies.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 4 adds 1d8.

name: Blinding Smite
description: The next time you hit with a melee weapon attack before the spell ends (concentration, up to 1 minute), your weapon blazes with light: the hit deals an extra 3d8 radiant damage, and the target makes a Constitution save or is blinded until the spell ends.
A blinded target repeats the save after each of its turns, ending the blindness on a success.

name: Blindness/Deafness
description: Pick 1 creature you can see within 30 ft. It makes a Constitution save; on a failure it is blinded or deafened (you choose) for 1 minute. It repeats the save after each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1 more target.

name: Blink
description: For 1 minute, after each of your turns, roll a d20. On 11 or higher you vanish to the Ethereal Plane (wasted if already there).
You return at the start of your next turn, or when the spell ends while ethereal, to a free space you can see within 10 ft of where you left (or the nearest free one).
While ethereal you see your plane in gray out to 60 ft, and only ethereal creatures can affect you or be affected by you. End it early as an action.

name: Blur
description: Your outline blurs for up to 1 minute (concentration). Attacks against you are made at disadvantage, unless the attacker doesn't rely on sight (e.g. blindsight) or sees through illusions (e.g. truesight).

name: Branding Smite
description: The next time you hit with a weapon attack before the spell ends (concentration, up to 1 minute), the hit deals an extra 2d6 radiant damage.
The target becomes visible if it was invisible, sheds dim light in a 5 ft radius, and can't turn invisible until the spell ends.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d6 to the extra damage.

name: Burning Hands
description: Flames fan out from your hands in a 15 ft cone. Each creature in the cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. Flammable objects in the cone that nobody is wearing or carrying catch fire.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

name: Call Lightning
description: A 10 ft tall storm cloud with a 60 ft radius forms 100 ft above you (it fails without room). Cast outdoors in a storm, you command that storm instead and damage gains 1d10.
Pick a point you can see within 120 ft: lightning hits it, and each creature within 5 ft makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d10 lightning damage, half on a success.
On later turns, until the spell ends, you can use your action to strike again at the same or a new point.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 adds 1d10 damage.

name: Calm Emotions
description: Each humanoid in a 20 ft radius sphere within 60 ft makes a Charisma save (it may fail on purpose). On each failure, pick one effect, for up to 1 minute (concentration):
Suppress: any charm or fear on it is paused, resuming afterwards if its time hasn't run out.
Indifference: it stops being hostile to creatures you choose, until it is attacked, harmed by a spell, or sees a friend harmed. Afterwards it is hostile again unless the DM rules otherwise.

name: Chain Lightning

m.text: Fur; amber, glass or a crystal rod; 3 silver pins

description: Lightning strikes one target you can see within 150 ft, then 3 bolts leap to up to 3 other targets within 30 ft of it. Targets can be creatures or objects; each takes only one bolt.
Every target makes a Dexterity save: 10d8 lightning, half on a success.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 6 adds one more leaping bolt.

name: Charm Person
description: Pick a humanoid you can see within 30 ft. It makes a Wisdom save, with advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. Failing, it is charmed for 1 hour, and sees you as a friendly acquaintance. Harming it ends the charm.
It knows afterwards that you magically influenced it.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 target; they must be within 30 ft of each other.

name: Chill Touch

summary.upcast: 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11, 4d8 at level 17

description: A ghostly hand grips a creature within 120 ft: make a ranged spell attack. A hit deals 1d8 necrotic damage, and the target cannot heal until your next turn starts. An undead target you hit also attacks you at disadvantage through the end of your next turn.
Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11 and 4d8 at level 17.

name: Chromatic Orb

m.text: a diamond worth 50 gp

description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature you can see within 90 ft. Pick the orb's type first: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or thunder. A hit deals 3d8 damage of that type.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d8 for each slot level above 1.

name: Circle of Death

m.text: Crushed black pearl powder worth 500 gp

description: Negative energy bursts in a 60 ft radius sphere around a point within 150 ft. Every creature in it makes a Constitution save: 8d6 necrotic, half on a success.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 6 adds 2d6.

name: Circle of Power
description: For up to 10 minutes (concentration) a 30 ft aura moves with you. Friendly creatures in it, you included, have advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
When one of them succeeds on such a save that would normally halve the damage, it takes no damage instead.

name: Clairvoyance

m.text: Focus worth 100 gp: jeweled horn (hearing) or glass eye (seeing)

description: You place an invisible sensor within 1 mile, in a place you know (visited or seen) or an obvious spot you don't, such as behind a door or around a corner. It stays put for up to 10 minutes (concentration) and can't be attacked or touched.
Choose seeing or hearing; you sense through the sensor as if you stood there. As an action you can switch senses. Creatures that see invisible things notice a fist-sized glowing orb.

name: Cloud of Daggers

m.text: Sliver of glass

description: Spinning daggers fill a 5 ft cube centred on a point within 60 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration). Entering the cube on a turn (first time only) or beginning a turn inside deals 4d4 slashing damage to a creature. No save or attack roll.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 2d4 damage.

name: Cloudkill
description: A 20 ft radius sphere of poison fog centers on a point within 120 ft for up to 10 minutes (concentration). It spreads around corners and is heavily obscured; strong wind ends it.
A creature that starts its turn in it, or enters it for the first time that turn, makes a Constitution save: 5d8 poison, half on a success. Holding breath doesn't help.
As each of your turns begins, the fog rolls 10 ft away from you, sinking into low ground and openings.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 5 adds 1d8.

name: Color Spray

m.text: a pinch of powder or sand coloured red, yellow and blue

description: Roll 6d10 for a pool of hit points. Creatures in a 15 ft cone are affected in order of lowest current hit points first, skipping unconscious creatures and those that cannot see.
Each creature whose hit points fit within what is left of the pool is blinded until the spell ends (1 round), and its hit points are subtracted from the pool.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 2d10 to the roll.

name: Command
description: Give a one-word order to a creature within 60 ft that you can see. It makes a Wisdom save or carries out the command on its next turn. Nothing happens if it is undead, does not understand your language, or the command would directly harm it.

Sample words: Approach (comes toward you, stopping within 5 ft), Drop (lets go of what it holds), Flee (moves away fast), Grovel (falls prone), Halt (no move, no actions). The DM rules on other words; if the target cannot obey, the spell ends.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 target; they must be within 30 ft of each other.

name: Commune

m.text: Incense and a vial of holy or unholy water

description: You reach your deity or a divine agent and ask up to 3 yes-or-no questions within the minute. Each gets a true answer, though the DM may say "unclear" if it lies outside the deity's knowledge, or give a short phrase if one word would mislead.
Each casting after the first before your next long rest has a cumulative 25% chance of no answer, rolled secretly by the DM.

name: Commune With Nature
description: You learn up to 3 facts of your choice about the land within 3 miles of you outdoors, or 300 ft in caves and natural underground. It fails where building has replaced nature, such as towns and dungeons.
Topics: land and bodies of water; dominant flora, fauna, minerals or peoples; mighty celestials, elementals, fey, fiends or undead; the pull of other planes; buildings.

name: Compelled Duel
description: A creature you can see within 30 ft makes a Wisdom save. If it fails, for 1 minute (concentration) it has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you. To move more than 30 ft from you it needs a Wisdom save; success lifts the limit that turn.

The spell ends if you attack another creature or cast a spell at a hostile creature besides the target, if an ally damages the target or aims a harmful spell at it, or if you finish a turn over 30 ft away.

name: Comprehend Languages

m.text: a pinch of soot and salt

description: For 1 hour, you understand any spoken language you hear. If you touch a surface bearing writing, you can read it too, taking about 1 minute per page.
It does not reveal hidden meaning, secret codes or non-written symbols. Ritual.

name: Compulsion
description: Chosen creatures you can see within 30 ft that can hear you make a Wisdom save (creatures immune to charm pass). Those who fail are affected for up to 1 minute (concentration).

Bonus action each turn: name a horizontal direction. On its next turn each target must use as much movement as it can going that way, though it may act first. It avoids obvious deadly hazards but will provoke opportunity attacks. After moving, it repeats the save to end the effect.

name: Cone of Cold

m.text: A small crystal or glass cone

description: Freezing air blasts from your hands in a 60 ft cone. Each creature there makes a Constitution save: 8d8 cold, half on a success. A creature it kills turns into a frozen statue until it thaws.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 5 adds 1d8.

name: Confusion

m.text: 3 nut shells

description: Each creature in a 10 ft radius sphere around a point within 90 ft makes a Wisdom save or is confused for up to 1 minute (concentration). It can't take reactions and rolls a d10 at the start of each turn:
1: It moves its full speed in a random direction (roll a d8) and takes no action.
2-6: It doesn't move or act.
7-8: It uses its action to melee attack a random creature in reach, or does nothing if none is in reach.
9-10: It moves and acts normally.
Each time it ends a turn it repeats the save, ending the effect on a success.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 4 widens the sphere by 5 ft.

name: Contact Other Plane
description: You reach out to a demigod, a long-dead sage's spirit or some other strange entity from another plane. Make a DC 15 Intelligence save.
Fail: you take 6d6 psychic damage and go insane until you finish a long rest: you can't take actions, understand speech or read, and you speak only gibberish. Greater restoration cures it.
Success: you may ask up to 5 questions while the spell lasts. Each gets a one-word reply (yes, no, maybe, never, irrelevant or unclear), or a short phrase if one word would mislead.

name: Contagion
description: Melee spell attack vs a creature in reach; on a hit it catches a disease you pick. At the end of each of its turns it makes a Constitution save: 3 failures lock it in for 7 days with no more saves; 3 successes cure it, ending the spell. Disease cures work.
Blinding Sickness: blinded; disadvantage on Wisdom checks and saves.
Filth Fever: disadvantage on Strength checks, saves and Strength attacks.
Flesh Rot: disadvantage on Charisma checks; vulnerable to all damage.
Mindfire: disadvantage on Intelligence checks and saves; acts as if confused in combat.
Seizure: disadvantage on Dexterity checks, saves and Dexterity attacks.
Slimy Doom: disadvantage on Constitution checks and saves; any damage stuns it until its next turn ends.

name: Contingency

m.text: Ivory statuette of yourself set with gems, worth 1,500 gp

description: Choose a spell you can cast of 5th level or lower, with a casting time of 1 action, that can target you. Cast it together with this spell, spending both slots, and describe a trigger.

The stored spell takes effect on you alone the first time the trigger happens, whether you want it or not, and contingency ends. You can have only one contingency at a time; casting another ends the first. It also ends if the statuette isn't on you.

name: Continual Flame

m.text: Ruby dust worth 50 gp, used up

description: An object you touch gives off a flame as bright as a torch until dispelled. It looks like real fire but makes no heat and needs no air. You can cover or hide it, but nothing smothers or douses it.

name: Control Water

m.text: A drop of water and a pinch of dust

description: Control freestanding water in a cube up to 100 ft wide within 300 ft. Pick an effect now; later, as an action, repeat or switch:
Flood: still water rises up to 20 ft. In open water, a 20 ft wave crosses the area each turn instead, carrying Huge or smaller vehicles (25% capsize chance).
Part Water: the water splits into two walls around a trench.
Redirect Flow: the water moves the way you choose, even uphill.

Whirlpool (water 50 ft square, 25 ft deep): pulls things within 25 ft 10 ft closer. Entering or starting a turn there: Strength save or 2d8 bludgeoning and caught (half, free on a success). Swim out: Athletics vs your save DC (disadvantage if caught).

name: Conjure Animals
description: Fey spirits in beast form appear in free spaces you can see within 60 ft. Pick one group:
• 1 beast of CR 2 or lower
• 2 beasts of CR 1 or lower
• 4 beasts of CR 1/2 or lower
• 8 beasts of CR 1/4 or lower

They count as fey, are friendly, and share one initiative; they obey your spoken orders (no action needed) or else just defend themselves. One reduced to 0 hit points vanishes. The DM has their stats.
higherLevels: Slot 5 doubles the number of creatures, slot 7 triples it, slot 9 quadruples it.

name: Conjure Barrage

m.text: 1 piece of ammunition or a thrown weapon

description: You throw a nonmagical weapon or shoot a piece of nonmagical ammunition, and copies of it spray out in a 60 ft cone. Each creature in the cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d8 damage of the weapon's or ammunition's type on a failure, or half on a success.

name: Conjure Elemental

m.text: Burning incense (air), soft clay (earth), sulfur and phosphorus (fire), or water and sand (water)

description: Choose a 10 ft cube of air, earth, fire or water within 90 ft. A matching elemental of CR 5 or lower appears within 10 ft of it for up to 1 hour (concentration), vanishing at 0 HP.
It is friendly to your group, rolls its own initiative and obeys your spoken orders (no action needed); unordered, it only defends itself. The DM has its stats.
If your concentration breaks, it stays but turns hostile and may attack. You can't dismiss it; it vanishes 1 hour after you summoned it.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 5 raises the CR by 1.

name: Conjure Fey
description: A fey creature of CR 6 or lower, or a fey spirit in the shape of a beast of CR 6 or lower, appears in a free space you can see within 90 ft. It vanishes at 0 HP or when the spell ends (concentration, up to 1 hour).
It is friendly to your group, rolls its own initiative and obeys your spoken orders (no action needed) if they fit its alignment; unordered, it only defends itself. The DM has its stats.
If your concentration breaks, it stays but turns hostile and may attack. You can't dismiss it; it vanishes 1 hour after you summoned it.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 6 raises the CR by 1.

name: Conjure Minor Elementals
description: Elementals appear in free spaces you can see within 90 ft for up to 1 hour (concentration). Pick one option:
• 1 elemental of CR 2 or lower
• 2 elementals of CR 1 or lower
• 4 elementals of CR 1/2 or lower
• 8 elementals of CR 1/4 or lower

Each vanishes at 0 HP or when the spell ends. They are friendly to your group, act on one shared initiative and follow your spoken orders (no action needed); unordered, they only defend themselves. The DM has their stats.
higherLevels: A 6th-level slot doubles the number summoned; an 8th-level slot triples it.

name: Conjure Volley

m.text: A piece of ammunition or a thrown weapon

description: Shoot a nonmagical piece of ammunition or throw a nonmagical weapon at a point within 150 ft. Hundreds of copies rain down in a 40 ft radius, 20 ft high cylinder there, then vanish.
Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity save: 8d8 damage of the weapon's or ammunition's type, half on a success.

name: Conjure Woodland Beings

m.text: One holly berry for each creature summoned

description: Fey creatures appear in free spaces you can see within 60 ft for up to 1 hour (concentration). Pick one option:
• 1 fey creature of CR 2 or lower
• 2 fey creatures of CR 1 or lower
• 4 fey creatures of CR 1/2 or lower
• 8 fey creatures of CR 1/4 or lower

Each vanishes at 0 HP or when the spell ends. They are friendly to your group, act on one shared initiative and follow your spoken orders (no action needed); unordered, they only defend themselves. The DM has their stats.
higherLevels: A 6th-level slot doubles the number summoned; an 8th-level slot triples it.

name: Cordon of Arrows

summary.upcast: +2 pieces of ammunition per slot level above 2

m.text: 4 or more arrows or bolts

description: You push 4 nonmagical arrows or bolts into the ground within 5 ft to guard the area for 8 hours. When you cast, you can name creatures it ignores.

Each time another creature comes within 30 ft of them (first time that turn) or finishes its turn that close, one piece flies at it: Dexterity save or 1d6 piercing damage. That piece is then destroyed; the spell ends when none are left.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 lets you use 2 more pieces of ammunition.

name: Counterspell

cast.trigger: when you see a creature within 60 ft casting a spell

description: You try to stop a spell as it is being cast. If it is 3rd level or lower, it simply fails with no effect.
Higher-level spells (4th or above) need an ability check with your spellcasting ability, DC 10 + the spell's level; succeed and it fails.
higherLevels: The spell fails automatically if its level is no higher than the slot you used.

name: Create Food and Water
description: You make 30 gallons of water and 45 pounds of food within 30 ft, on the ground or in containers: a day's supply for up to 15 humanoids or 5 steeds. The food is bland but filling and spoils if not eaten within 24 hours; the water stays clean.

name: Create or Destroy Water

m.text: a drop of water for creating, or a few grains of sand for destroying

description: Pick one effect, aimed within 30 ft:
• Create: fills an open container with up to 10 gallons of fresh water, or rain soaks a 30 ft cube and douses flames there.
• Destroy: removes up to 10 gallons of water from an open container, or burns off fog in a 30 ft cube.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 10 gallons, or 5 ft to the cube's side.

name: Create Undead

m.text: Per corpse: a clay pot of grave dirt, a clay pot of brackish water, and a black onyx stone worth 150 gp

description: Cast only at night. Up to 3 Medium or Small humanoid corpses within 10 ft rise as ghouls under your control (the DM has their stats).
Bonus action: command any of them within 120 ft (one order for all); unordered, they just defend themselves. An order holds until the task is done.
Control lasts 24 hours. Recast before it ends to keep up to 3 of them for another 24 hours instead of making new ones.
higherLevels: 7th-level slot: 4 ghouls. 8th: 5 ghouls or 2 ghasts or wights. 9th: 6 ghouls, 3 ghasts or wights, or 2 mummies.

name: Creation

m.text: A tiny bit of the same matter as the item

description: Using Shadowfell shadow-stuff, you make a nonliving object of plant matter (cloth, rope, wood) or mineral (stone, crystal, metal) within 30 ft. It fits in a 5 ft cube and must be a form and material you have seen. How long it lasts depends on the material (mixed: use the shortest):
Vegetable matter: 1 day. Stone or crystal: 12 hours. Precious metals: 1 hour. Gems: 10 minutes. Adamantine or mithral: 1 minute.
Any spell that uses something made this way as its material component fails.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 5 grows the cube by 5 ft.

name: Crown of Madness
description: A humanoid you can see within 120 ft makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you for up to 1 minute (concentration).
Each of its turns, before moving, it must spend its action on a melee attack at a creature you mentally pick (not itself). If you pick none, or none is in reach, it acts normally.
On your later turns you must use your action to keep control, or the spell ends. It repeats the save after each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.

name: Crusader's Mantle
description: A 30 ft radius aura of holy power surrounds you and moves with you for up to 1 minute (concentration). Every nonhostile creature in it, you included, adds 1d4 radiant damage to its weapon hits.

name: Cure Wounds
description: A creature you touch regains 1d8 hit points plus your spellcasting modifier. Undead and constructs are not healed.
higherLevels: Healing rises by 1d8 for each slot level above 1.

name: Dancing Lights

m.text: a bit of phosphorus, wychwood or a glowworm

description: Up to 4 torch-like lights hover at points within 120 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration), or you can fuse them into one glowing humanoid form. Each gives dim light in a 10 ft radius.
Use a bonus action to shift any of them up to 60 ft. Keep them within 20 ft of one another; any that ends up over 120 ft from you vanishes.

name: Darkness

m.text: Bat fur; pitch or coal

description: Magical darkness fills a 15 ft radius sphere around a point within 60 ft for up to 10 minutes (concentration). It spreads around corners; darkvision can't see through it and nonmagical light can't light it.
If you pick an object you hold or one nobody is wearing or carrying, the darkness moves with it; covering it with something opaque, like a bowl or helm, blocks the darkness.
Any light from a spell of 2nd level or lower that overlaps it is dispelled.

name: Darkvision

m.text: Pinch of dried carrot or an agate

description: You touch a willing creature. For 8 hours it can see in the dark, with darkvision out to 60 ft.

name: Daylight
description: For 1 hour, a 60 ft radius sphere of bright light, with dim light for another 60 ft, spreads from a point within 60 ft.
If you pick an object you hold or one nobody is wearing or carrying, the light moves with it; covering it with something opaque, like a bowl or helm, blocks the light.
Any darkness from a spell of 3rd level or lower that overlaps it is dispelled.

name: Death Ward
description: You touch a creature and shield it for 8 hours. The first time damage would drop it to 0 HP, it stays at 1 HP and the spell ends.
If it is still active when an effect would kill the target outright without dealing damage, that effect fails against it and the spell ends.

name: Destructive Wave
description: You strike the ground and divine force ripples out. Each creature you choose within 30 ft makes a Constitution save.
Fail: 5d6 thunder plus 5d6 radiant or necrotic (your choice), and it falls prone. Success: half damage, and it stays standing.

name: Detect Evil and Good
description: For up to 10 minutes (concentration) you sense whether aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends or undead are within 30 ft, and where. You also sense places or objects within 30 ft that are consecrated or desecrated.
1 ft of stone, 1 inch of metal, thin lead or 3 ft of wood or dirt blocks it.

name: Detect Magic
description: For up to 10 minutes (concentration) you sense magic within 30 ft. As an action you can see a faint aura around any visible magical creature or object there, and learn its school of magic.
1 ft of stone, 1 inch of metal, thin lead or 3 ft of wood or dirt blocks it. Ritual.

name: Detect Poison and Disease

m.text: a yew leaf

description: For up to 10 minutes (concentration) you sense poisons, poisonous creatures and diseases within 30 ft, learning what kind each one is and where.
1 ft of stone, 1 inch of metal, thin lead or 3 ft of wood or dirt blocks it. Ritual.

name: Detect Thoughts

m.text: 1 copper piece

description: As an action (and when casting), read the surface thoughts of one creature you see within 30 ft; Intelligence 3 or lower, or no language: immune.

Probe deeper (action): Wisdom save. Fail: you learn its reasoning, mood and what weighs on it. Success: spell ends. It notices; until you switch, it can use its action on an Intelligence contest to end the spell.

Or, when casting or as an action, sense unseen thinking creatures within 30 ft (2 ft of rock, 2 inches of metal or any lead sheet blocks this; the same immunity applies), then read them while they stay in range.

name: Dimension Door
description: You teleport to any spot within 500 ft that you can see, picture, or describe by distance and direction ("200 ft straight down").
You can take objects you can carry, plus one willing creature your size or smaller within 5 ft, with its gear up to its carrying capacity.
If the arrival space is occupied, you and anyone with you take 4d6 force damage and stay put.

name: Disguise Self
description: For 1 hour, or until you dismiss it as an action, you and your gear look different. You can seem 1 ft taller or shorter, thin, fat or in between, but must keep the same basic limb arrangement.
It fails touch inspection: a fake hat would let hands pass through. A creature can use an action to inspect you and make an Investigation check against your spell save DC to see through it.

name: Disintegrate

m.text: A lodestone and a pinch of dust

description: A green ray hits a target you can see within 60 ft: a creature, an object, or something made of magical force (such as a wall of force).
A creature makes a Dexterity save or takes 10d6 + 40 force. If that drops it to 0 HP, it turns to gray dust with all it carries except magic items; only true resurrection or wish can revive it.
A Large or smaller nonmagical object or force creation is destroyed outright; a bigger one loses a 10 ft cube. Magic items are unaffected.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 6 adds 3d6.

name: Dispel Evil and Good

m.text: Holy water or powdered silver and iron

description: For up to 1 minute (concentration), attacks by celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead against you have disadvantage. Either option below also ends the spell:
Break Enchantment: as an action, touch a creature you can reach to free it from being charmed, frightened or possessed by one of those creature types.

Dismissal: as an action, make a melee spell attack against one of those creatures in reach. On a hit it makes a Charisma save or is sent to its home plane (undead to the Shadowfell, fey to the Feywild if already home).

name: Dispel Magic
description: Target one creature, object or magical effect within 120 ft. Any spell of 3rd level or lower affecting it is ended.
Against each spell of 4th level or above, roll an ability check with your spellcasting ability against DC 10 + its level; a success ends that spell.
higherLevels: Spells of a level no higher than the slot you used end automatically.

name: Dissonant Whispers
description: You whisper a jarring tune that only one creature you choose within 60 ft can hear. It makes a Wisdom save, taking 3d6 psychic damage on a failure or half on a success.

On a failure it must also spend its reaction, if it has one, to move as far from you as its speed allows, steering clear of obvious hazards like fire or a pit. Deafened creatures pass the save automatically.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

name: Divination

m.text: Incense and a fitting sacrificial offering, together worth 25 gp, used up

description: With an offering, you ask a god or its servants one question about a goal, event or activity happening within 7 days. The DM answers truthfully, maybe as a brief phrase, a riddle-like rhyme or an omen. It ignores later changes, like new spells or allies lost.
Each casting after the first before your next long rest has a cumulative 25% chance of a random reading, rolled secretly by the DM.

name: Divine Favor
description: For 1 minute (concentration), each time you hit with a weapon attack you add 1d4 radiant damage.

name: Dominate Beast
description: A beast you can see within 60 ft makes a Wisdom save (advantage if you or your allies are fighting it) or is charmed by you for up to 1 minute (concentration).

While on the same plane, you can give it simple orders telepathically (no action needed) and it does its best to obey; with no new orders it defends itself. As an action, take full control until the end of your next turn: it does only what you choose, and you can spend your reaction to make it use its own.
Each time it takes damage it repeats the save, ending the spell on a success.
higherLevels: Concentration rises to 10 minutes with a 5th-level slot, 1 hour with 6th, and 8 hours with 7th or higher.

name: Dominate Person
description: A humanoid you can see within 60 ft makes a Wisdom save (advantage if you or your allies are fighting it) or is charmed by you for up to 1 minute (concentration).

While on the same plane, you can give it simple orders telepathically (no action needed) and it does its best to obey; with no new orders it defends itself. As an action, take full control until the end of your next turn: it does only what you choose, and you can spend your reaction to make it use its own.
Each time it takes damage it repeats the save, ending the spell on a success.
higherLevels: Concentration rises to 10 minutes with a 6th-level slot, 1 hour with 7th, and 8 hours with 8th or higher.

name: Drawmij's Instant Summons

m.text: A sapphire worth 1,000 gp

description: You mark an object of 10 pounds or less, no longer than 6 ft, and its name appears invisibly on the sapphire. Each casting needs a new sapphire.

Later, as an action, speak its name and crush the gem: it lands in your hand from any distance, even across planes, and the spell ends. If someone else holds or carries it, it stays put but you learn who has it and roughly where.
Dispel magic or similar on the sapphire ends the spell.

name: Dream

m.text: Sand, ink, and a quill taken from a sleeping bird

description: Target a creature you know on your plane (not one that doesn't sleep, like an elf). You, or a willing creature you touch, fall into a trance as the messenger, aware of your surroundings but unable to move or act.

While the target sleeps, the messenger appears in its dreams to talk and shape the dream; the target remembers it all. If it is awake, wait for sleep or end the spell. The messenger can leave the trance at any time.
Nightmare: deliver up to 10 words, then the target makes a Wisdom save (disadvantage if you have a piece of its body). Fail: it gains no benefit from that rest and takes 3d6 psychic on waking.

name: Druidcraft
description: Choose one minor nature trick within 30 ft:
• A tiny, harmless sign (a golden orb for sun, a cloud for rain, snowflakes) forecasts your local weather for the next 24 hours; it lasts 1 round.
• Instantly bloom a flower, burst open a seed pod or unfurl a leaf bud.
• Produce an instant, harmless sensory effect that fits in a 5 ft cube: drifting leaves, a breeze, a small animal noise, a faint smell.
• Ignite or put out a candle, torch or small campfire.

name: Eldritch Blast

summary.upcast: 1d10 at level 5, 1d10 at level 11, 1d10 at level 17

description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 120 ft. A hit deals 1d10 force damage.
At level 5 you fire 2 beams, at level 11 3 beams and at level 17 4 beams. Each beam needs its own attack roll and may go at the same or different targets.

name: Elemental Weapon

summary.upcast: slots 5-6: +2 bonus and 2d4; slots 7+: +3 bonus and 3d4

description: A nonmagical weapon you touch turns magic for up to 1 hour (concentration). Pick acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder: the weapon gains +1 on attack rolls, and each hit adds 1d4 damage of that type.
higherLevels: Slot 5 or 6: +2 and 2d4; slot 7 or higher: +3 and 3d4.

name: Enhance Ability

m.text: Fur or a feather from a beast

description: You touch a creature and give it one boon for up to 1 hour (concentration):
Bear's Endurance: advantage on Constitution checks, plus 2d6 temporary hit points that vanish when the spell ends.
Bull's Strength: advantage on Strength checks; carrying capacity doubles.
Cat's Grace: advantage on Dexterity checks; no damage from falls of 20 ft or less unless incapacitated.
Eagle's Splendor, Fox's Cunning, Owl's Wisdom: advantage on Charisma, Intelligence or Wisdom checks.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1 more target.

name: Enlarge/Reduce

m.text: Pinch of powdered iron

description: A creature or unattended object you can see within 30 ft grows or shrinks for up to 1 minute (concentration); an unwilling creature resists with a Constitution save. Its worn and carried gear changes too; dropped items return to normal.
Enlarge: twice the size (1 category up, as space allows), 8 times the weight. Advantage on Strength checks and saves; its weapons deal +1d4 damage.
Reduce: half size (1 category down), one-eighth the weight. Disadvantage on Strength checks and saves; its weapons deal 1d4 less damage (minimum 1).

name: Ensnaring Strike
description: Your next weapon hit within 1 minute (concentration) also conjures thorny vines around the target. It makes a Strength save (advantage if Large or bigger) or is restrained.

Each of its turns begins with 1d6 piercing damage while the vines hold. The target, or anyone able to touch it, can use an action and beat your spell save DC with a Strength check to free it, ending the vines.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

name: Entangle
description: Thick weeds and vines sprout across a 20 ft square within 90 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration), making it difficult terrain. Anyone inside when you cast it makes a Strength save or is restrained.
To break free, a restrained creature spends an action and beats your spell save DC with a Strength check. The growth fades when the spell ends.

name: Enthrall
description: You speak a captivating stream of words. Creatures you choose that you can see within 60 ft and that hear you make a Wisdom save. Creatures immune to charm pass automatically; one your party is fighting has advantage.
On a failure, for 1 minute or until it can't hear you, it has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice anyone but you. Being incapacitated or unable to speak ends the spell.

name: Evard's Black Tentacles

m.text: A bit of tentacle from a giant octopus or giant squid

description: Black tentacles fill a 20 ft square of ground you can see within 90 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration), making it difficult terrain.

A creature entering it for the first time on a turn, or starting its turn there, makes a Dexterity save or takes 3d6 bludgeoning and is restrained until the spell ends. One already restrained takes 3d6 bludgeoning when its turn starts there.
A restrained creature can use its action for a Strength or Dexterity check (its pick) against your spell save DC to break free.

name: Expeditious Retreat
description: For up to 10 minutes (concentration), you may Dash as a bonus action on every turn, starting with the turn you cast this.

name: Eyebite
description: Your eyes turn to dark voids for up to 1 minute (concentration). On casting and as an action each later turn, a creature you can see within 60 ft makes a Wisdom save or suffers your chosen effect. A creature that succeeded can't be targeted again.
Asleep: unconscious until it takes damage or someone uses an action to wake it.
Panicked: frightened; on each turn it Dashes away from you by the safest short route unless trapped, until it is 60 ft or more away and can't see you.
Sickened: disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. It repeats the save as each of its turns ends, ending this on a success.

name: Fabricate
description: You turn raw materials you can see within 120 ft into a finished item of the same stuff, such as trees into a wooden bridge or hemp into rope. The item can be Large or smaller (fitting a 10 ft cube or eight joined 5 ft cubes), or Medium at most (one 5 ft cube) for metal, stone or other minerals.
Quality matches the raw materials. You can't make or change creatures or magic items, and fine work like jewelry, weapons, glass or armor needs proficiency with the matching artisan's tools.

name: Faerie Fire
description: Pick a 20 ft cube within 60 ft. Objects in it glow blue, green or violet (your choice); each creature in it makes a Dexterity save and, on a failure, glows too. This lasts up to 1 minute (concentration).
Glowing things shed dim light for 10 ft. Attacks against them have advantage if the attacker can see them, and invisibility does not hide them.

name: False Life

m.text: a little alcohol or distilled spirits

description: You gain 1d4+4 temporary hit points for 1 hour.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 5 temporary hit points.

name: Fear

m.text: White feather or hen's heart

description: An illusion of their worst fears hits each creature in a 30 ft cone. Each makes a Wisdom save or drops what it holds and is frightened for up to 1 minute (concentration).

A frightened creature must Dash away from you by the safest route on each of its turns, unless it has nowhere to go. If it ends its turn where it can't see you, it makes a Wisdom save; a success ends the spell on it.

name: Feather Fall

cast.trigger: when you or a creature within 60 ft falls

m.text: a small feather or piece of down

description: Reaction when you or a creature within 60 ft falls. Up to 5 falling creatures within range drop at only 60 ft per round for 1 minute. One that lands before then takes no falling damage and lands on its feet, and the spell ends for it.

name: Feign Death

m.text: Pinch of graveyard dirt

description: You touch a willing creature and it falls into a deathlike trance for 1 hour, or until you touch it as an action to end it. Inspection and spells that check its status show it as dead.
It is blinded and incapacitated, its speed is 0, and it resists all damage except psychic. Any disease or poison it has or gets does nothing until the spell ends.

name: Find Familiar

m.text: 10 gp of charcoal, incense and herbs, burned

description: Forms: bat, cat, crab, frog, hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, poisonous snake, fish, rat, raven, sea horse, spider or weasel. A celestial, fey or fiend, it obeys you, has its own initiative, never attacks.
Within 100 ft: telepathy; it delivers your touch spells by reaction. As an action, borrow its senses until your next turn; you are blind and deaf meanwhile.
At 0 hit points it vanishes until recast. An action dismisses it to a pocket dimension (recall within 30 ft) or forever. Recast to change its form; only 1 familiar.

name: Find Steed
description: A spirit steed appears in a free space within 30 ft: warhorse, pony, camel, elk, mastiff or another the DM allows. Beast stats, but celestial, fey or fiend (you pick); Intelligence 5 or less becomes 6; it understands one language you speak.
It serves as your mount. While you ride it, your self-only spells can also target it. Telepathy within 1 mile.
At 0 hit points, or dismissed as an action, it vanishes; recasting restores it at full hit points. One steed only; an action releases it for good.

name: Find the Path

m.text: Divining tools (bones, cards, runes or similar) worth 100 gp, plus an item taken from the destination

description: Name a fixed place on your plane that you know. For up to 1 day (concentration), while on its plane, you know its distance and direction, and at every fork you know which way is shortest and most direct, though not always safest.
The spell fails for a place on another plane, one that moves (like a mobile fortress), or a vague one ("a green dragon's lair").

name: Find Traps
description: You learn whether any trap lies within 120 ft and in your line of sight. A trap here means anything deliberately built to cause a sudden harmful or unwanted effect, for example a glyph of warding, an alarm ward or a pit trap, but not natural hazards like a weak floor or hidden sinkhole.
You learn only that a trap exists and the general kind of danger, not where it is.

name: Fire Bolt

summary.upcast: 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 11, 4d10 at level 17

description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature or object within 120 ft. A hit deals 1d10 fire damage. A flammable object it hits catches fire if nobody is wearing or carrying it.
Damage rises to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 11 and 4d10 at level 17.

name: Fire Shield

m.text: A bit of phosphorus or a firefly

description: Wispy flames surround you for 10 minutes, giving bright light to 10 ft and dim light 10 ft beyond. You can end it early as an action.
Warm shield: resistance to cold damage. Chill shield: resistance to fire damage.
When a creature within 5 ft hits you with a melee attack, it takes 2d8 fire (warm) or 2d8 cold (chill).

name: Fireball

m.text: Pellet of bat guano and sulfur

description: A streak flies to a point you pick within 150 ft and blooms into a 20 ft radius burst of flame. Each creature there makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
The blast wraps around corners and sets alight any flammable objects in the area that nobody is wearing or carrying.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 3.

name: Flame Blade

m.text: Leaf of sumac

description: A scimitar-sized blade of fire forms in your free hand for up to 10 minutes (concentration). If you let go it vanishes, but you can call it back as a bonus action.
Use your action to swing it as a melee spell attack, dealing 3d6 fire damage on a hit. It sheds bright light for 10 ft and dim light for 10 ft more.
higherLevels: Every 2 slot levels above 2 add 1d6 damage.

name: Flame Strike

m.text: A pinch of sulfur

description: Holy fire pours down in a 10 ft radius, 40 ft high cylinder around a point within 60 ft. Each creature in it makes a Dexterity save: 4d6 fire plus 4d6 radiant, half on a success.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 5 adds 1d6 to the fire or the radiant damage (your pick).

name: Flaming Sphere

m.text: Bit of tallow, pinch of brimstone, dusting of powdered iron

description: A 5 ft wide ball of fire appears in a free space within 60 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration). A creature that ends its turn within 5 ft of it makes a Dexterity save: 2d6 fire damage, half on a success.

As a bonus action, roll it up to 30 ft; a creature it rams makes the save and the sphere stops for the turn. It hops 5 ft barriers and 10 ft pits, ignites unattended flammables, and lights 20 ft bright plus 20 ft dim.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d6 damage.

name: Flesh to Stone

m.text: A pinch of lime, water and earth

description: A creature you can see within 60 ft, with a body of flesh, makes a Constitution save. On a failure it is restrained as it starts to harden.
While restrained, it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. 3 successes (not necessarily in a row) end the spell; 3 failures turn it to stone, petrified for the duration.
If you keep concentration for the full minute, it stays stone until the effect is removed. Breaking the statue leaves matching injuries if it is restored.

name: Fly

m.text: Wing feather from any bird

description: You touch a willing creature; it gains a flying speed of 60 ft for up to 10 minutes (concentration). When the spell ends, it falls if still in the air, unless it can stop itself.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 adds 1 more target.

name: Fog Cloud
description: You raise a 20 ft radius sphere of fog centred on a point within 120 ft, for up to 1 hour (concentration). It spreads around corners and heavily obscures the area. A wind of 10 mph or more disperses it early.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 20 ft to the radius.

name: Forbiddance

m.text: Holy water, rare incense, and 1,000 gp of powdered ruby

description: You ward up to 40,000 sq ft of floor, 30 ft high, for 1 day. Nothing can teleport in or enter by portal (like gate), the Astral or Ethereal Plane, the Feywild, the Shadowfell or plane shift.

Choose creature types from celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead. One of them entering the area for the first time on a turn, or starting its turn there, takes 5d10 radiant or necrotic (your choice when cast). A password you set spares the speaker.
Areas can't overlap another forbiddance. Casting it in the same place daily for 30 days makes it last until dispelled; the last casting uses up the materials.

name: Freedom of Movement

m.text: A leather strap tied around an arm or similar limb

description: For 1 hour, a willing creature you touch ignores difficult terrain, and no spell or magical effect can lower its speed, paralyze it or restrain it.
It can spend 5 ft of movement to slip free of nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a grapple. Being underwater doesn't hamper its movement or attacks.

name: Friends

m.text: a little makeup applied to your face as you cast

description: For up to 1 minute (concentration) you have advantage on Charisma checks aimed at one creature of your choice that is not hostile to you.
When the spell ends, that creature realizes you used magic on it and turns hostile toward you. A violent one may attack you; others may seek revenge in other ways, at the DM's discretion.

name: Gaseous Form

m.text: Gauze scrap and a wisp of smoke

description: A willing creature you touch, with all its gear, becomes a misty cloud for up to 1 hour (concentration). Dropping to 0 hit points ends it; incorporeal creatures are unaffected.

As mist it only flies, at 10 ft, can enter others' spaces and slip through cracks (liquids count as solid surfaces), resists nonmagical damage, has advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves, and hovers even if stunned.
It can't speak, attack, cast spells, or handle objects, and can't use or drop what it carries.

name: Geas
description: Give a command to a creature you can see within 60 ft that understands you: do some service, or avoid some act. It makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you for 30 days. Each time it directly works against your order it takes 5d10 psychic, at most once a day.
Any order is allowed except one meaning certain death; a suicidal order ends the spell. You can end it as an action; remove curse, greater restoration or wish also ends it.
higherLevels: A 7th- or 8th-level slot makes it last 1 year; a 9th-level slot makes it last until one of those spells ends it.

name: Gentle Repose

m.text: Pinch of salt, plus a copper piece on each eye that must stay there

description: Touch a corpse or other remains: for 10 days it neither decays nor can become undead.
Days under this spell don't count toward the time limit of spells like raise dead, so it buys more time to revive the creature.

name: Giant Insect
description: Within 30 ft, up to 10 centipedes, 3 spiders, 5 wasps or 1 scorpion grow into giant versions for up to 10 minutes (concentration). The DM may allow other bugs, like a bee becoming a giant wasp.
They obey your spoken commands and act on your turn in combat; the DM has their stats and runs their actions and movement.
Each stays giant until the spell ends, it drops to 0 HP, or you use an action to end it for that creature.

name: Globe of Invulnerability

m.text: A glass or crystal bead that breaks when the spell ends

description: A still, shimmering barrier forms in a 10 ft radius around you for up to 1 minute (concentration).

Spells cast from outside at 5th level or lower can't affect creatures or objects inside, even if cast with a higher slot. They can still target things inside, but do nothing, and their areas leave the inside untouched.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 6 blocks spells one level higher.

name: Glyph of Warding

m.text: Incense and powdered diamond worth 200 gp, used up

description: You hide a glyph on a surface (up to 10 ft across) or in a closable object; moving the object over 10 ft breaks it, ending the spell. Finding it: Investigation vs your spell save DC.
Set the trigger (touch, opening, approach, reading), optionally by height, weight, creature kind or alignment; exempt creatures, e.g. by password. It ends once triggered.
Explosive Runes: 20 ft radius sphere, spreading around corners; Dexterity save, 5d8 acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder (set when made), half on a success.
Spell Glyph: store a prepared spell (3rd level or lower, one target or an area). It fires at the intruder; summons appear beside it; concentration spells run their full duration.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 adds 1d8 to explosive runes, and a spell glyph can hold a spell up to the slot's level.

name: Goodberry

m.text: a sprig of mistletoe

description: Up to 10 berries appear in your hand, magical for 24 hours. A creature can use its action to eat one: it restores 1 hit point and feeds the creature for a day.
Berries not eaten within 24 hours lose their magic.

name: Grasping Vine
description: A vine sprouts in a free space you can see within 30 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration). When you cast it, it lashes at a creature you can see within 30 ft of it: Dexterity save or be pulled 20 ft straight toward the vine.
Bonus action on each of your turns: lash at the same creature or a new one.

name: Grease

m.text: a bit of pork rind or butter

description: Slick grease covers a 10 ft square on the ground within 60 ft for 1 minute, making it difficult terrain. Anyone standing in it when you cast it makes a Dexterity save or falls prone.
A creature that enters or ends its turn there makes the same save.

name: Greater Invisibility
description: You or a creature you touch turns invisible for up to 1 minute (concentration), along with what it wears and carries while on its person. Unlike invisibility, attacking or casting spells doesn't end it.

name: Greater Restoration

m.text: Diamond dust worth 100 gp, used up

description: Touch a creature to remove one exhaustion level or end one of these:
• one effect charming or petrifying it
• one curse, including attunement to a cursed magic item
• any reduction to one of its ability scores
• one effect reducing its hit point maximum

name: Guardian of Faith
description: A Large spectral guardian with your deity's sword and shield fills a free space you can see within 30 ft for 8 hours.
Any creature hostile to you that first moves within 10 ft of it on a turn makes a Dexterity save: 20 radiant damage, half on a success. The guardian disappears once it has dealt 60 damage in total.

name: Guards and Wards

m.text: Burning incense, brimstone and oil, knotted string, umber hulk blood, and a silver rod worth 10 gp

description: Ward up to 2,500 sq ft of floor, up to 20 ft tall, any shape, for 24 hours, split across floors you walk while casting if you like. Name creatures it ignores, plus an optional password protecting its speaker.
Corridors: fog heavily obscures them; at each junction others have a 50% chance of heading the wrong way.
Doors: arcane-locked; up to 10 can look like plain wall.
Stairs: webbed (as web), regrowing within 10 minutes if cleared.
Plus one: dancing lights in 4 corridors, magic mouth or stinking cloud in 2 places, gust of wind in one room, or suggestion in a 5 ft square.
Dispel magic removes one effect per success. Recast daily for a year: permanent.

name: Guidance
description: Touch a willing creature. Once before the spell ends, it can roll a d4 and add the result to one ability check of its choice, rolling either before or after the d20. The spell then ends.

name: Guiding Bolt
description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 120 ft. A hit deals 4d6 radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against the target before the end of your next turn has advantage, thanks to the glow.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

name: Gust of Wind

m.text: 1 legume seed

description: A 60 ft long, 10 ft wide line of strong wind blows from you for up to 1 minute (concentration). Each creature that starts its turn in it makes a Strength save or is pushed 15 ft away from you along the line.
Moving toward you inside the line costs 2 ft per 1 ft. The wind clears gas and vapor, snuffs candles and torches, and gives shielded flames like lanterns a 50% chance to go out.
Each turn, a bonus action turns the wind to a new direction.

name: Hail of Thorns

summary.upcast: +1d10 per slot level above 1, up to 6d10

description: Your next ranged weapon hit before the spell ends (concentration, up to 1 minute) makes thorns burst from your weapon or ammunition. Besides the attack's normal effect, the target and every creature within 5 ft of it make a Dexterity save, taking 1d10 piercing damage on a failure or half on a success.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d10 for each slot level above 1, to a maximum of 6d10.

name: Hallow

m.text: Herbs, oils and incense worth 1,000 gp, used up

description: Over 24 hours you charge a radius up to 60 ft around a touched point (not overlapping another hallow). Celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead are barred from entering and from charming, frightening or possessing anyone inside; such effects end on entering. You may exempt types.
Add one effect, for everyone or a group you name (a deity's followers, orcs). A creature entering or starting its turn there may make a Charisma save to ignore it until it leaves.

Courage: no frightened. Darkness or Daylight (beats lower-level magic). Energy Protection or Vulnerability: one type, not bludgeoning, piercing or slashing. Everlasting Rest: dead can't become undead. Extradimensional Interference: no teleport or planar travel. Fear: frightened inside. Silence. Tongues: shared understanding.

name: Hallucinatory Terrain

m.text: Stone, twig, and some green plant

description: Natural terrain in a 150 ft cube within 300 ft looks, sounds and smells like other natural terrain for 24 hours: a road can seem a swamp, a cliff a gentle slope. Buildings, gear and creatures look unchanged.

Touch isn't fooled, so anyone walking in likely sees through it. If touch doesn't reveal it, a creature studying it closely can roll Investigation vs your spell save DC; success shows it only as a faint image over the real ground.

name: Harm
description: A creature you can see within 60 ft makes a Constitution save: 14d6 necrotic, half on a success. This can't drop it below 1 HP.
On a failure, its hit point maximum also drops by the damage taken for 1 hour. Anything that cures disease restores the maximum early.

name: Haste

m.text: Shaving of licorice root

description: A willing creature you can see within 30 ft is sped up for up to 1 minute (concentration): double speed, +2 AC, advantage on Dexterity saves, and 1 extra action each turn. That action can only be Attack (a single weapon attack), Dash, Disengage, Hide or Use an Object.
When the spell ends, a wave of lethargy hits: the target can't move or act until after its next turn.

name: Heal
description: A creature you can see within 60 ft regains 70 HP, and any blindness, deafness and diseases on it end. Constructs and undead are unaffected.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 6 heals 10 more HP.

name: Healing Word
description: A creature you can see within 60 ft regains 1d4 hit points plus your spellcasting modifier. Undead and constructs are not healed.
higherLevels: Healing rises by 1d4 for each slot level above 1.

name: Heat Metal

m.text: Piece of iron and a flame

description: A manufactured metal object you can see within 60 ft, such as a metal weapon or medium or heavy metal armor, glows red-hot. Any creature touching it takes 2d8 fire damage on the cast, and again each time you use a bonus action on later turns.

A creature holding or wearing it that takes the damage makes a Constitution save or drops it if able. If it can't or won't let go, it attacks and makes ability checks with disadvantage until your next turn begins.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d8 damage.

name: Hellish Rebuke

cast.trigger: when a creature you can see within 60 ft damages you

description: Reaction when a creature you can see within 60 ft damages you. Flames wreath it, and it makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d10 fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d10 for each slot level above 1.

name: Heroes' Feast

m.text: Gem-studded bowl worth 1,000 gp, used up

description: A grand feast appears for you and up to 12 other creatures. Eating takes 1 hour; the food then vanishes and the benefits begin.

Each diner is cured of all disease and poison, becomes immune to poison and to being frightened, and has advantage on Wisdom saves. Its hit point maximum also rises by 2d10, and it gains that many HP. All of this lasts 24 hours.

name: Heroism
description: A willing creature you touch gains courage for 1 minute (concentration). It cannot be frightened, and each of its turns begins with temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting modifier.
When the spell ends, it loses any temporary hit points this spell gave it.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 target.

name: Hex

summary.upcast: slots 3-4: concentration up to 8 hours; slots 5+: up to 24 hours

m.text: the petrified eye of a newt

description: Curse one creature within 90 ft you can see for up to 1 hour (concentration). Each time you hit it with an attack you deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage, and it has disadvantage on checks with one ability score you choose when you cast the spell.
If it drops to 0 hit points, you can move the curse to a new creature within range as a bonus action on a later turn. Remove curse on the target ends the spell early.
higherLevels: A level 3 or 4 slot lets concentration last up to 8 hours; level 5 or higher, up to 24 hours.

name: Hold Monster

m.text: A small straight piece of iron

description: A creature you can see within 90 ft makes a Wisdom save or is paralyzed for up to 1 minute (concentration). Undead are unaffected.
It repeats the save as each of its turns ends, breaking free on a success.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 5 adds a target; all must be within 30 ft of each other.

name: Hold Person

m.text: Small bit of straight iron

description: Pick a humanoid you can see within 60 ft. It makes a Wisdom save or is paralyzed. It repeats the save when each of its own turns finishes; a success frees it and ends the spell on it.
higherLevels: A higher slot holds 1 extra humanoid per level above 2; targets must stand within 30 ft of one another.

name: Hunger of Hadar

m.text: Pickled octopus tentacle

description: A 20 ft radius sphere of freezing void opens on a point within 150 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration). No light can brighten it, creatures fully inside are blinded, it is difficult terrain, and its whispers carry 30 ft.
A creature starting its turn inside takes 2d6 cold damage (no save). One ending its turn inside makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d6 acid damage.

name: Hunter's Mark
description: Mark a creature you can see within 90 ft as your quarry for up to 1 hour (concentration). Each hit you land on it with a weapon deals 1d6 extra damage, and you have advantage on Perception and Survival checks to find it.
If it drops to 0 hit points first, you can spend a bonus action on a later turn to move the mark to a new creature.
higherLevels: A level 3 or 4 slot lets concentration last up to 8 hours; level 5 or higher, up to 24 hours.

name: Hypnotic Pattern

m.text: Glowing incense stick or crystal vial of phosphorescent material

description: A swirl of colors flashes briefly in a 30 ft cube within 120 ft. Each creature in it that sees the pattern makes a Wisdom save or is charmed for up to 1 minute (concentration). While charmed it is incapacitated and its speed is 0.
The effect ends for a creature if it takes any damage or someone uses an action to shake it awake.

name: Ice Storm

m.text: Some dust and a little water

description: Hard hail pounds a 20 ft radius, 40 ft high cylinder around a point within 300 ft. Each creature in it makes a Dexterity save: 2d8 bludgeoning plus 4d6 cold, half on a success.
Until your next turn ends, the area is difficult terrain.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 4 adds 1d8 bludgeoning.

name: Identify

m.text: a pearl worth 100 gp and an owl feather

description: Over 1 minute, touch an object throughout the casting. A magic item reveals what it does and how to use it, whether it needs attunement, and its charges. You also learn which spells, if any, are affecting it, what they are, and which spell made it, if one did.
Touch a creature instead to learn which spells currently affect it. Ritual.

name: Illusory Script

m.text: lead-based ink worth 10 gp (used up)

description: Over 1 minute you write on parchment, paper or similar material, laying an illusion on it that lasts 10 days. You and anyone you name see it as normal writing with the meaning you intended. Everyone else sees an unreadable, unknown script.
Alternatively, others can see a wholly different message, in another hand and a language you know.
Dispelling it destroys both the script and the illusion. A creature with truesight can read the hidden message. Ritual.

name: Inflict Wounds
description: You strike a creature you touch with a melee spell attack. If it hits, the target takes 3d10 necrotic damage.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d10 for each slot level above 1.

name: Insect Plague

m.text: Some sugar grains, grain kernels and a smear of fat

description: Biting locusts fill a 20 ft radius sphere around a point within 300 ft for up to 10 minutes (concentration). It spreads around corners, is lightly obscured and is difficult terrain.
Each creature in it when it appears makes a Constitution save: 4d10 piercing, half on a success. A creature also saves the first time each turn it enters, and whenever it ends its turn there.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 5 adds 1d10.

name: Invisibility

m.text: Eyelash in gum arabic

description: A creature you touch turns invisible for up to 1 hour (concentration), along with whatever it wears or carries while on its person. The spell ends for a target as soon as it attacks or casts a spell.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1 more target.

name: Jump

m.text: a grasshopper's hind leg

description: You touch a creature. For 1 minute its jump distance is 3 times normal.

name: Knock
description: Pick an object you can see within 60 ft that blocks access: a door, box, chest, manacles, padlock and so on. A mundane lock opens, or a stuck or barred object comes free; with several locks, only one opens.
An arcane lock on it is suppressed for 10 minutes; meanwhile the object opens and closes normally.
Casting it makes a loud knock heard up to 300 ft away.

name: Legend Lore

m.text: Incense worth 250 gp (used up) and 4 ivory strips worth 50 gp each

description: Pick a person, place or object by name or description, and a short summary of its notable lore comes to mind: current tales, forgotten stories, even secrets. Things of no legendary importance give nothing.
The more you already know about it, the more precise the result. The lore is true but may come as riddling or poetic language.

name: Leomund's Secret Chest

m.text: A 3 by 2 by 2 ft chest of rare materials worth 5,000 gp and a Tiny replica worth 50 gp

description: Touch the chest and its replica to hide the chest and contents (up to 12 cubic ft of nonliving matter) on the Ethereal Plane.
Action, touching the replica: the chest appears on the ground within 5 ft. Action, touching both: send it back.

From day 60, each day adds a cumulative 5% chance the spell ends. Recasting, losing the replica, or ending it as an action also ends it. If the chest is on the Ethereal Plane then, it is lost for good.

name: Leomund's Tiny Hut

m.text: Small crystal bead

description: A 10 ft radius dome of force forms over you and stays put for 8 hours; leaving it ends the spell. It holds you plus up to nine Medium or smaller creatures, and fails if anything larger, or more than nine creatures, is inside.
Those inside at casting pass through freely; everything else is barred, and spells and magical effects can't cross it. Inside stays comfortable and dry.
You can make the inside dim or dark. Opaque from outside (any color), clear from inside.

name: Lesser Restoration
description: You touch a creature and end one disease or one condition on it: blinded, deafened, paralyzed or poisoned.

name: Levitate

m.text: Small leather loop, or golden wire bent into a cup on a long shank

description: One creature or object you can see within 60 ft, weighing up to 500 pounds, rises up to 20 ft and hangs there for up to 10 minutes (concentration). An unwilling creature that passes a Constitution save is unaffected.

It moves only by pushing or pulling on fixed things in reach, like climbing. Each turn you can raise or lower it up to 20 ft: within your move if it is you, otherwise with your action (it must stay in range). When the spell ends it floats gently down.

name: Light

m.text: a firefly or phosphorescent moss

description: One object up to 10 ft across glows for 1 hour: bright light 20 ft out, dim light another 20 ft, in any colour you pick. Something opaque placed over it hides the glow. Casting the spell again, or dismissing it as an action, ends it.
If a hostile creature is holding or wearing the object, it can make a Dexterity save to avoid the spell.

name: Lightning Arrow
description: Your next ranged weapon attack before the spell ends (concentration, up to 1 minute) turns the ammunition, or the thrown weapon, into lightning. Roll the attack normally: 4d8 lightning damage on a hit, half on a miss, instead of the weapon's damage.
Hit or miss, each creature within 10 ft of the target makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d8 lightning damage, half on a success. The ammunition or weapon then returns to normal.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 adds 1d8 to both damage rolls.

name: Lightning Bolt

m.text: Fur scrap and an amber, crystal or glass rod
