description: A 100 ft long, 5 ft wide line of lightning blasts out from you, aimed where you like. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 lightning damage, half on a success. It sets fire to flammable objects nobody is wearing or carrying.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 adds 1d6 damage.

name: Locate Animals or Plants

m.text: Bit of bloodhound fur

description: Name or describe a specific kind of beast or plant. If any lie within 5 miles, you sense how far away the closest one is and in which direction.

name: Locate Creature

m.text: A bit of bloodhound fur

description: For up to 1 hour (concentration) you sense the direction of a creature you name or describe, if it is within 1,000 ft, and which way it moves.

It finds a specific creature you know, or the nearest of a kind (like a human or a unicorn) if you have seen one within 30 ft at least once. It fails if the creature is in another form (such as polymorphed) or running water 10 ft wide lies directly between you.

name: Locate Object

m.text: Forked twig

description: Name or describe an object familiar to you. For up to 10 minutes (concentration) you sense the direction to it if it is within 1,000 ft, and which way it moves if it is moving.

It finds a specific object only if you have seen it up close (within 30 ft) at least once, or else the nearest object of a kind, like a certain sort of weapon or jewelry. Any lead, even a thin sheet, in the direct path blocks it.

name: Longstrider

m.text: a pinch of dirt

description: A creature you touch gains +10 ft of speed for 1 hour.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 target.

name: Mage Armor

m.text: Scrap of cured leather

description: Touch a willing creature that wears no armor. For 8 hours its base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor or you dismiss it as an action.

name: Mage Hand
description: A floating hand appears at a point within 30 ft and stays for 1 minute. It vanishes if you dismiss it as an action, cast the spell again, or it is ever more than 30 ft from you.

Use your action to control it, moving it up to 30 ft each time: handle an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or fetch an item from an open container, or pour out a vial. It cannot attack, activate magic items, or carry over 10 lb.

name: Magic Circle

m.text: Holy water or powdered silver and iron worth 100 gp, used up

description: A 10 ft radius, 20 ft tall cylinder of glowing runes forms on the ground at a point within 10 ft for 1 hour. Pick one or more types: celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, undead. A creature of a chosen type:
• can't willingly enter by nonmagical means; teleporting or planar travel in needs a Charisma save first;
• has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets inside;
• can't charm, frighten or possess anyone inside.
You can reverse it instead, trapping such creatures inside and shielding those outside.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 adds 1 hour.

name: Magic Jar

m.text: A gem, crystal, reliquary or other ornate container worth 500 gp

description: Your soul enters the container; your body goes catatonic. You perceive from there but can't move or react. Only action: send your soul up to 100 ft, home (ending the spell) or into a humanoid.
Possess: a humanoid you can see within 100 ft makes a Charisma save (protection from evil and good or magic circle blocks it). Fail: souls swap. Success: no retry for 24 hours.
You use the host's stats but keep your alignment, Int, Wis, Cha and class features. Action: return to the container within 100 ft.
Host dies: Charisma save vs your DC, or you die. Container breaks or spell ends: you return to your body, dying if it is dead or over 100 ft away.

name: Magic Missile
description: You fire 3 darts of force at creatures you choose within 120 ft that you can see. Each dart strikes automatically for 1d4+1 force damage. You can send every dart at one target or split them across several.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 dart.

name: Magic Mouth

m.text: Honeycomb and jade dust worth 10 gp, used up

description: You set a spoken message of 25 words or less (up to 10 minutes long) in an object you can see within 30 ft that nobody wears or carries, plus a trigger.

The trigger must be something seen or heard within 30 ft, like a creature coming close or a bell ringing. A mouth then appears (on a statue's mouth if any) and speaks in your voice. Choose whether it speaks once or every time.

name: Magic Weapon
description: You touch a nonmagical weapon. For up to 1 hour (concentration) it becomes magic, with +1 to attack and damage rolls.
higherLevels: Slot 4 or 5: +2; slot 6 or higher: +3.

name: Major Image

m.text: Bit of fleece

description: You make an illusion of an object, creature or other visible thing up to a 20 ft cube, at a spot you can see within 120 ft, for up to 10 minutes (concentration). It has sound, smell and temperature but can't harm or deafen.
While in range, use your action to move it within range and animate it, even making it talk.
Things pass through it. A creature can spend its action on an Investigation check vs your spell save DC; if it succeeds, the image turns faint for it.
higherLevels: With a slot of 6th level or higher, it lasts until dispelled with no concentration.

name: Mass Cure Wounds
description: Choose up to 6 creatures in a 30 ft radius sphere around a point within 60 ft. Each regains 3d8 + your spellcasting modifier HP. Constructs and undead are unaffected.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 5 adds 1d8.

name: Mass Healing Word
description: You call out words of healing: up to 6 creatures you choose and can see within 60 ft each regain 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points. Undead and constructs are unaffected.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 adds 1d4 healing.

name: Mass Suggestion

m.text: A snake's tongue plus honeycomb or a drop of sweet oil

description: Up to 12 creatures you can see within 60 ft that can hear and understand you make a Wisdom save (immune to charm: unaffected). On a failure, each follows a reasonable-sounding course of action you propose in a sentence or two, for up to 24 hours or until it's done.
An obviously harmful order, like stabbing itself, fails. You can set a trigger for the act; if it never happens, nothing is done. Damage from you or your companions frees that creature.
higherLevels: Lasts 10 days with a 7th-level slot, 30 days with 8th, and a year and a day with 9th.

name: Meld Into Stone
description: Spend movement to merge, with your gear, into a stone object or surface big enough to hold you. Nonmagical senses can't detect you.
Inside you can't see out, Perception checks to hear have disadvantage, and you can cast spells on yourself. You can't move, except to step out where you entered (ending it).

If the stone is partly destroyed or reshaped so you no longer fit, you are expelled and take 6d6 bludgeoning damage; total destruction or transmutation deals 50. You land prone in the nearest free space.

name: Melf's Acid Arrow

m.text: Powdered rhubarb leaf and an adder's stomach

description: Make a ranged spell attack against a target within 90 ft. On a hit it takes 4d4 acid damage now and 2d4 acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss it takes half the first damage and none later.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d4 to both the first and the later damage.

name: Mending

m.text: two lodestones

description: Touch a single break or rip no longer than 1 ft in any direction, such as a snapped chain link, torn cloak or leaking wineskin. It mends with no trace of damage.
It can physically fix a magic item or construct, but cannot bring back any magic the object lost.

name: Message

m.text: a short piece of copper wire

description: Point at a creature within 120 ft and whisper. Only it hears you, and it can whisper an answer only you hear.

It works through solid objects if you know the target is behind the barrier and are familiar with it. Magical silence, 1 ft of stone, 1 inch of metal, thin lead or 3 ft of wood blocks it. It bends around corners and through openings.

name: Minor Illusion

m.text: a bit of fleece

description: Within 30 ft you make either a sound or the image of an object, lasting 1 minute. A sound can be a whisper to a scream, steady or in bursts. An image fits in a 5 ft cube and makes no sound, smell or light. Dismiss it as an action, or recast to end it.
A creature that spends an action examining it makes an Investigation check against your spell save DC to see through it, and it then looks faint to them. Touching it also exposes it.

name: Mirror Image
description: 3 illusory copies of you appear for 1 minute, moving with you so no one can tell which is real. Dismiss them as an action.

When a creature attacks you, roll a d20: with 3 copies left, 6 or higher makes it target a copy; with 2, 8 or higher; with 1, 11 or higher. A copy has AC 10 + your Dexterity modifier and is destroyed when hit; nothing else harms it. The spell ends with the last one.
Blindsight or truesight ignores them.

name: Mislead
description: You turn invisible and an illusory double appears where you stand, for up to 1 hour (concentration). Attacking or casting a spell ends your invisibility; the double remains.
Action: move the double up to twice your speed, making it gesture, talk and act as you like.
You can see and hear through it as if there. Bonus action each turn: switch between its senses and yours; while on its senses you are blind and deaf to your own surroundings.

name: Misty Step
description: In a puff of silver mist you teleport up to 30 ft to an empty space you can see. It costs only a bonus action and needs just a spoken word, no gestures.

name: Modify Memory
description: A creature you can see within 30 ft makes a Wisdom save (advantage if you're fighting it) or is charmed for up to 1 minute (concentration): incapacitated and oblivious to all but your voice. Damage or another spell targeting it ends the spell with no change.
While charmed, describe changes to an event from the last 24 hours that lasted 10 minutes or less: erase, sharpen, alter or invent. It must understand you; the change holds only if you finish first.
A false memory may not change behaviour; absurd ones are dismissed. Remove curse or greater restoration undoes it.
higherLevels: Reach older events: 7 days at 6th level, 30 days at 7th, 1 year at 8th, any time at 9th.

name: Moonbeam

m.text: Moonseed seeds and a piece of opalescent feldspar

description: A 5 ft radius, 40 ft tall cylinder of pale moonlight (dim light) shines on a point within 120 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration).

A creature entering it for the first time on a turn, or starting its turn there, makes a Constitution save: 2d10 radiant damage, half on a success. Shapechangers save at disadvantage and, on a failure, revert and can't change shape while in the light.
On each later turn you can use your action to move the beam up to 60 ft.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d10 damage.

name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound

m.text: A tiny silver whistle, a bit of bone and a thread

description: An invisible phantom watchdog sits in a free space you can see within 30 ft for 8 hours. It ends if you dismiss it (action) or move over 100 ft away. Only you see it; it can't be harmed.
It barks loudly if a Small or larger creature gets within 30 ft without saying your password. It sees invisible things and into the Ethereal Plane, and ignores illusions.
As each of your turns begins it bites a hostile creature within 5 ft: attack bonus = spellcasting modifier + proficiency bonus, 4d8 piercing.

name: Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum

m.text: Thin lead sheet, opaque glass, cotton or cloth, and powdered chrysolite

description: You secure a cube from 5 to 100 ft on a side within 120 ft for 24 hours, or until you end it as an action. Pick any of these:
• Sound can't cross the edge.
• The edge looks dark and foggy, blocking sight and darkvision.
• Divination sensors can't appear inside or pass through the edge.
• Divination spells can't target creatures inside.
• No teleporting in or out.
• No planar travel inside.
Casting it on the same spot daily for a year makes it permanent.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 4 adds 100 ft to the cube's side (200 ft at 5th).

name: Move Earth

m.text: An iron blade and a small bag of mixed clay, loam and sand

description: For up to 2 hours (concentration) you reshape dirt, sand or clay in an area up to 40 ft on a side within 120 ft: raise or lower ground, dig or fill a trench, build or flatten a wall, form a pillar. Changes can reach half the area's largest side (20 ft for a 40 ft square) and take 10 minutes to finish.
Every 10 minutes of concentration you may pick a new area. The slow change rarely traps or hurts creatures.
Natural stone and stonework can't be shaped, though they shift with the ground, and unstable buildings may collapse. Plants ride along with the moved earth.

name: Nondetection

m.text: Diamond dust worth 25 gp, sprinkled on the target and used up

description: For 8 hours, a willing creature, place or object (up to 10 ft in any dimension) that you touch is hidden from divination. Divination magic can't target it, and magical scrying sensors can't see it.

name: Nystul's Magic Aura

m.text: Small square of silk

description: Touch a willing creature or an object nobody else holds or wears. For 24 hours it fools divination; pick one or both effects. Repeat it on the target daily for 30 days and it lasts until dispelled.
False Aura: to magic detection, a mundane object seems magical, a magic one mundane, or its aura shows a school you choose. You can let anyone handling it sense the fake magic.
Mask: effects that sense creature type (Divine Sense, a symbol trigger) read it as the type or alignment you choose.

name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere

m.text: A small crystal sphere

description: A globe of cold bursts in a 60 ft radius sphere at a point within 300 ft. Each creature there makes a Constitution save: 10d6 cold, half on a success.
If it hits water, the surface freezes 6 inches deep over a 30 ft square for 1 minute, trapping swimmers; one can use an action for a Strength check vs your spell save DC to break out.
Or keep it as a sling-stone globe. You or someone you hand it to can throw it (40 ft) or sling it; it bursts on impact as above. It explodes on its own after 1 minute.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 6 adds 1d6.

name: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere

m.text: Two half-spheres, one of clear crystal and one of gum arabic

description: A force sphere encloses a Large or smaller creature or object within 30 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration). An unwilling creature makes a Dexterity save to avoid it.
Nothing passes in or out, though the creature inside can breathe. The sphere takes no damage, and no attack or effect crosses it either way. Disintegrate destroys it without harming what's inside.
The weightless sphere can be lifted by others, or rolled from inside as an action at up to half the creature's speed.

name: Otto's Irresistible Dance
description: A creature you can see within 30 ft starts dancing in place for up to 1 minute (concentration); there is no save to resist it at first. Creatures immune to charm are unaffected.
While dancing it spends all its movement dancing without leaving its space, has disadvantage on Dexterity saves and attack rolls, and attacks against it have advantage.
As an action, it can make a Wisdom save to stop; success ends the spell.

name: Pass Without Trace

m.text: Ashes of a burned mistletoe leaf and a spruce sprig

description: Shadow and hush surround you for up to 1 hour (concentration). You and each creature you choose within 30 ft of you get +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks, leave no tracks or other trace, and can't be tracked except by magic.

name: Passwall

m.text: A pinch of sesame seeds

description: A passage up to 5 ft wide, 8 ft tall and 20 ft deep opens for 1 hour at a point you can see within 30 ft on wood, plaster or stone (wall, ceiling or floor). It doesn't weaken the structure around it.
When it closes, anything still inside is pushed safely out to the nearest free space by the surface you cast it on.

name: Phantasmal Force

m.text: Bit of fleece

description: A creature you can see within 60 ft makes an Intelligence save. On a failure, only it perceives an illusion you design (object, creature or effect up to a 10 ft cube), with sound and temperature. Undead and constructs are immune.
It believes the phantasm. As an action it can try an Investigation check vs your spell save DC; success ends the spell.
Each of your turns, if it is in or within 5 ft of a phantasm that could plausibly hurt it, it takes 1d6 psychic damage.

name: Phantasmal Killer
description: A creature you can see within 120 ft sees its worst fear, visible only to it. It makes a Wisdom save or is frightened for up to 1 minute (concentration).
At the start of each of its turns while frightened, it makes another Wisdom save: failure deals 4d10 psychic; success ends the spell.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 4 adds 1d10.

name: Phantom Steed
description: A Large, half-real horse with saddle, bit and bridle appears on the ground within 30 ft for 1 hour; you choose its look. Its gear vanishes if taken over 10 ft from it.
You or a creature you pick can ride it. It has riding horse stats, but speed 100 ft and 10 miles an hour (13 at a fast pace).
It ends if the steed takes damage or you dismiss it (action). The steed then fades over 1 minute so the rider can get off.

name: Planar Ally
description: You call on a powerful being you know (a god, primordial, demon prince or similar). It sends a loyal celestial, elemental or fiend to a free space within 60 ft. You may request one by name, but the DM may send another.

It owes you nothing; you bargain for a task and payment. Rough guide: 100 gp per minute, 1,000 gp per hour, 10,000 gp per day (up to 10 days). Fitting tasks may cost half or nothing, safe ones half, risky ones more; suicidal tasks are rarely accepted.
It leaves when done or when the term ends. With no deal it returns home at once. While serving it counts as a party member for XP.

name: Planar Binding

m.text: A jewel worth 1,000 gp, used up

description: A celestial, elemental, fey or fiend that stays within 60 ft for the whole hour of casting (often held in a reversed magic circle) makes a Charisma save. On a failure it serves you for 24 hours. If another spell summoned or made it, that spell lasts as long as this one.
It follows your instructions as well as it can, but a hostile one twists your words. If done early, it reports to you on your plane, or waits where you bound it.
higherLevels: Duration: 10 days at 6th level, 30 days at 7th, 180 days at 8th, a year and a day at 9th.

name: Plant Growth
description: Two uses:
1 action: normal plants in a 100 ft radius around a point within 150 ft grow thick and tangled. Creatures moving through spend 4 ft of movement per 1 ft. You can leave out any areas you like.
8 hours: plants in a half-mile radius around a point within 150 ft are enriched for 1 year and give double the usual harvest.

name: Poison Spray

summary.upcast: 2d12 at level 5, 3d12 at level 11, 4d12 at level 17

description: You puff noxious gas at a creature you can see within 10 ft. It makes a Constitution save or takes 1d12 poison damage.
Damage rises to 2d12 at level 5, 3d12 at level 11 and 4d12 at level 17.

name: Polymorph

m.text: A caterpillar cocoon

description: A creature you can see within 60 ft turns into a beast with CR no higher than its level or CR, for up to 1 hour (concentration). An unwilling target makes a Wisdom save to resist; shapechangers succeed automatically.
It takes the beast's stats, mental scores included, keeping only alignment and personality. Gear melds in and can't be used. It can't speak, cast spells, or do anything needing hands or speech.
It uses the beast's HP. At 0 HP it reverts with its old HP, and excess damage carries over; it ends early if the target dies.

name: Prayer of Healing
description: Over 10 minutes of prayer, up to 6 creatures you choose and can see within 30 ft each regain 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points. Undead and constructs are unaffected.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d8 healing.

name: Prestidigitation
description: Pick one minor trick within 10 ft:
• Harmless sensory effect: sparks, a gust, soft notes, an odd smell.
• Light or snuff a candle, torch or small campfire.
• Clean or soil an object up to 1 cubic ft.
• Chill, warm or flavour 1 cubic ft of non-living material for 1 hour.
• A colour, mark or symbol on a surface for 1 hour.
• A hand-sized trinket or illusory image until your next turn ends.
Up to 3 timed effects at once; dismiss one as an action.

name: Produce Flame

summary.upcast: 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11, 4d8 at level 17

description: A flame sits in your palm for 10 minutes, harmless to you and your gear, lighting a 10 ft radius brightly and a further 10 ft dimly. Dismiss it as an action, or recast, to end it.
When you cast it, or as an action later, you can throw it at a creature within 30 ft (ranged spell attack; 1d8 fire on a hit). Throwing it ends the spell.
Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11 and 4d8 at level 17.

name: Programmed Illusion

m.text: Fleece, plus 25 gp of jade dust

description: You set up a hidden illusion of an object, creature or other visible thing, up to a 30 ft cube, within 120 ft. Choose its sounds and actions (up to 5 minutes long) and a trigger based on what can be seen or heard within 30 ft of the area, such as a spoken password.
When triggered it plays out, then goes dormant for 10 minutes before it can trigger again. It lasts until dispelled.
Touching it shows it's fake. As an action, a creature can study it with Investigation vs your spell save DC; on a success it sees through it and its noises sound hollow.

name: Protection From Energy
description: A willing creature you touch gains resistance to one damage type you pick (acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder) for up to 1 hour (concentration).

name: Protection from Evil and Good

m.text: holy water, or powdered silver and iron (used up)

description: A willing creature you touch gains a ward for up to 10 minutes (concentration) against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead. Those creatures attack it at disadvantage and cannot possess it or charm or frighten it.
If one of them already has it charmed, frightened or possessed, it has advantage on any new save against that effect.

name: Protection from Poison
description: You touch a creature and cure a poison affecting it; if several afflict it, you end one you know about or a random one.
For 1 hour it also has advantage on saves against being poisoned and resistance to poison damage.

name: Purify Food and Drink
description: All non-magical food and drink in a 5 ft radius sphere centred on a point within 10 ft is cleansed of poison and disease. Ritual.

name: Raise Dead

m.text: A diamond worth 500 gp, used up

description: Touch a creature dead no longer than 10 days. If its soul is willing and free, it returns with 1 HP. Poisons and nonmagical diseases it had are cured; magical diseases and curses stay unless removed first.
Mortal wounds close but lost body parts don't regrow; without a vital part, like the head, the spell fails. Undead can't be raised.
The target takes a -4 penalty to attack rolls, saves and ability checks, shrinking by 1 after each long rest.

name: Rary's Telepathic Bond

m.text: Eggshell from two different kinds of creature

description: Up to 8 willing creatures you choose within 30 ft are linked telepathically for 1 hour. Creatures with Intelligence 2 or lower can't join.
Linked creatures can talk mind to mind at any distance, with or without a shared language, but not across planes.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement
description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 60 ft. On a hit, for up to 1 minute (concentration), its weapon attacks that use Strength deal only half damage.
After each of its turns, it makes a Constitution save; a success ends the spell.

name: Ray of Frost

summary.upcast: 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11, 4d8 at level 17

description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 60 ft. A hit deals 1d8 cold damage and cuts the target's speed by 10 ft until your next turn begins.
Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11 and 4d8 at level 17.

name: Ray of Sickness
description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 60 ft. A hit deals 2d8 poison damage, and the target makes a Constitution save or is poisoned until the end of your next turn.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d8 for each slot level above 1.

name: Reincarnate

m.text: Rare oils and unguents worth 1,000 gp, used up

description: Touch a dead humanoid, or a piece of one, dead no more than 10 days. If its soul is free and willing, a new adult body forms and it returns to life. It keeps its memories and abilities but swaps its race and racial traits for the new one's.

The DM picks the new race or rolls d100: 01-04 dragonborn, 05-13 hill dwarf, 14-21 mountain dwarf, 22-25 dark elf, 26-34 high elf, 35-42 wood elf, 43-46 forest gnome, 47-52 rock gnome, 53-56 half-elf, 57-60 half-orc, 61-68 lightfoot halfling, 69-76 stout halfling, 77-96 human, 97-00 tiefling.

name: Remove Curse
description: Your touch ends every curse on one creature or object. A cursed magic item keeps its curse, but its owner's attunement breaks, so the item can be taken off or thrown away.

name: Resistance

m.text: a miniature cloak

description: You touch a willing creature. Once before the spell ends, it can roll a d4 and add it to one saving throw of its choice, before or after rolling the save. The spell then ends.

name: Revivify

m.text: Diamonds worth 300 gp, used up

description: You touch a creature that died within the last minute; it comes back to life with 1 hit point. It can't revive a creature that died of old age, and doesn't restore lost body parts.

name: Rope Trick

m.text: Powdered corn extract and a twisted loop of parchment

description: You touch a rope up to 60 ft long. One end rises until the rope hangs straight up, and at the top an invisible entrance leads to an extradimensional space for 1 hour.

Climb the rope to get in. Up to 8 Medium or smaller creatures fit, and the rope can be pulled up out of sight. Attacks and spells can't cross the entrance, but those inside see out through a 3 ft by 5 ft window around the rope.
When the spell ends, everything inside falls out.

name: Sacred Flame

summary.upcast: 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11, 4d8 at level 17

description: Radiance falls on a creature you can see within 60 ft. It makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 radiant damage. Cover gives it no bonus to this save.
Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11 and 4d8 at level 17.

name: Sanctuary

m.text: a small silver mirror

description: Bonus action. Ward a creature within 30 ft for 1 minute. Anyone who targets it with an attack or harmful spell must first make a Wisdom save, or pick a new target or lose the attack or spell.
Area effects such as a fireball are not stopped. The ward ends if the warded creature attacks, or targets or catches a foe with a spell.

name: Scorching Ray
description: You fire 3 rays of fire at targets within 120 ft, all at one target or split among several. Make a separate ranged spell attack for each ray; each hit deals 2d6 fire damage.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1 more ray.

name: Scrying

m.text: A focus worth 1,000 gp, such as a crystal ball, silver mirror or font of holy water

description: Choose a creature on your plane to watch and hear for up to 10 minutes (concentration). It makes a Wisdom save, or may fail on purpose. On a success it's unaffected, and you can't scry it again for 24 hours.
Save modifiers: heard of it +5, met it +0, know it well -5; likeness or picture -2, possession or garment -4, body part such as hair or nail -10.

On a failure an invisible sensor follows within 10 ft of it, and you see and hear through it. Creatures that see invisible things see a fist-sized glowing orb. You can instead target a place you have seen; the sensor stays put there.

name: Searing Smite
description: Your next melee weapon hit before the spell ends (concentration, up to 1 minute) deals an extra 1d6 fire damage and sets the target alight.

Each time one of its turns starts while it burns, the target makes a Constitution save. A failure deals it 1d6 fire damage; a success ends the spell with no damage. The fire also goes out, ending the spell, if the target or someone within 5 ft spends an action to smother it, or if something douses it, such as plunging under water.
higherLevels: The extra damage on the hit rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

name: See Invisibility

m.text: Pinch of talc and a little powdered silver

description: For 1 hour, invisible creatures and objects are plainly visible to you. You also see into the Ethereal Plane, where creatures and things appear ghostly and see-through.

name: Seeming
description: Give any number of creatures you can see within 30 ft a new illusory look for 8 hours, or until you end it as an action. An unwilling target can make a Charisma save to avoid it.
You can change looks, clothing, armor, weapons and gear, and make each up to 1 ft shorter or taller, thinner or heavier. The body shape and limbs must stay the same.
The disguise fails to touch. As an action, a creature can make an Investigation check vs your spell save DC to spot it.

name: Sending

m.text: Short piece of fine copper wire

description: Send a message of twenty-five words or fewer to a creature you are familiar with. It hears it in its mind, knows you if it has met you, and can reply the same way right away. Any creature with Intelligence 1 or more understands it.
Distance is no limit, even across planes, but to another plane there is a 5% chance the message fails to arrive.

name: Shatter

m.text: Chip of mica

description: A painful burst of ringing sound erupts at a point within 60 ft. Each creature in a 10 ft radius sphere makes a Constitution save, taking 3d8 thunder damage, half on a success. Creatures of stone, crystal, metal or other inorganic material save at disadvantage. Unattended nonmagical objects in the area take the damage too.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d8 damage.

name: Shield

cast.trigger: when you're hit by an attack or targeted by magic missile

description: Until your next turn begins, you gain +5 AC, which also applies to the attack that triggered the spell. For the same time you take no harm from magic missile.

name: Shield of Faith

m.text: a small parchment with holy text written on it

description: A creature within 60 ft is surrounded by a shimmering field and gains +2 AC for up to 10 minutes (concentration).

name: Shillelagh

m.text: mistletoe, shamrock leaf, a club or quarterstaff

description: A club or quarterstaff you hold turns magical for 1 minute. Your melee attacks with it, for hit and damage, rely on your spellcasting ability rather than Strength, and it deals a d8. Recasting the spell or dropping the weapon ends it.

name: Shocking Grasp

summary.upcast: 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11, 4d8 at level 17

description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you touch, with advantage if it wears metal armor. A hit deals 1d8 lightning damage, and the target cannot take reactions until its next turn begins.
Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11 and 4d8 at level 17.

name: Silence
description: For up to 10 minutes (concentration), no sound can be made in or pass through a 20 ft radius sphere on a point within 120 ft.
Anything entirely inside is immune to thunder damage, and creatures entirely inside are deafened. Spells with a verbal component can't be cast there.

name: Silent Image

m.text: a bit of fleece

description: You create an image of an object, creature or effect within 60 ft, no larger than a 15 ft cube. It makes no sound, smell or other sensation, and lasts up to 10 minutes (concentration).

As an action you can move it anywhere in range, and its look can change to match. A creature that spends its action studying it can make an Investigation check against your spell save DC to see through it. Touching it reveals it.

name: Sleep

m.text: fine sand, rose petals or a cricket

description: Roll 5d8 to get a pool of hit points. Choose a point within 90 ft: creatures within 20 ft of it drop off in order of lowest current hit points, skipping those already unconscious. Each one's hit points are deducted from the pool, and a creature with more than what remains is unaffected.
Sleepers stay unconscious for 1 minute, or until they are hurt or someone spends an action shaking or slapping them. Undead and anything immune to charm are skipped.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 2d8 to the roll.

name: Sleet Storm

m.text: Dust and a few water drops

description: Freezing sleet fills a 40 ft radius, 20 ft tall cylinder on a point within 150 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration). The area is heavily obscured, open flames go out, and icy ground makes it difficult terrain.

A creature entering it for the first time on a turn, or starting its turn there, makes a Dexterity save or falls prone. Anyone concentrating inside must succeed on a Constitution save vs your spell save DC to keep concentrating.

name: Slow

m.text: Drop of molasses

description: Up to six creatures you choose in a 40 ft cube within 120 ft each make a Wisdom save or are slowed.

Slowed: half speed, -2 to AC and Dexterity saves, no reactions. On its turn it gets an action or a bonus action, not both, and only one attack. Casting a 1-action spell: roll a d20; on 11 or higher it takes effect next turn using that turn's action, or is lost.
It repeats the save after each of its turns; a success frees it.

name: Spare the Dying
description: Touch a living creature at 0 hit points. It becomes stable. Undead and constructs are unaffected.

name: Speak with Animals
description: For 10 minutes you can understand and talk with beasts. Their knowledge is limited, but they can tell you about nearby places and monsters, and may do a small favour at the DM's discretion. Ritual.

name: Speak with Dead

m.text: Burning incense

description: A corpse within 10 ft that still has a mouth, isn't undead, and wasn't targeted by this spell in the last 10 days can answer up to five of your questions within 10 minutes.
It knows only what it knew alive, in the languages it knew. Answers are usually short, cryptic or repetitive, and it may lie if hostile to you. It learns nothing new and can't predict the future.

name: Speak with Plants
description: For 10 minutes, plants within 30 ft gain a little awareness: they talk with you, obey simple commands, and can tell you what passed through the area in the last day (creatures, weather and so on).

You can make plant-choked difficult terrain normal, or turn ground with plants into difficult terrain, while the spell lasts. Plants can move branches and tendrils but not uproot. You can talk to plant creatures, and free creatures held by entangle.

name: Spider Climb

m.text: Drop of bitumen and a spider

description: For up to 1 hour (concentration), a willing creature you touch can walk up, down and across walls and upside down on ceilings with its hands free, and climbs at its walking speed.

name: Spike Growth

m.text: 7 sharp thorns or 7 small sharpened twigs

description: The ground in a 20 ft radius around a point within 150 ft sprouts hard spikes and thorns for up to 10 minutes (concentration). It is difficult terrain; every 5 ft a creature moves into or through it deals it 2d4 piercing damage.
The spikes look natural. A creature that couldn't see the area at casting must pass a Perception check vs your spell save DC to notice the danger before entering.

name: Spirit Guardians

m.text: Holy symbol

description: Spirits circle you to 15 ft for up to 10 minutes (concentration), angelic or fey if you are good or neutral, fiendish if evil. Choose any creatures you can see to be unaffected.

Affected creatures move at half speed in the area. Each time one enters it (first time that turn) or begins its turn there, it makes a Wisdom save, taking 3d8 radiant damage (necrotic if you are evil), half on a success.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 adds 1d8 damage.

name: Spiritual Weapon
description: A floating spectral weapon appears within 60 ft for 1 minute or until you recast this. As part of casting, attack a creature within 5 ft of it with a melee spell attack: a hit deals 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier force damage.
As a bonus action on your turn, move it up to 20 ft and attack again with it. It looks like whatever weapon you choose.
higherLevels: Every 2 slot levels above 2 add 1d8 damage.

name: Staggering Smite
description: Your next melee weapon hit before the spell ends (concentration, up to 1 minute) deals an extra 4d6 psychic damage.
The target then makes a Wisdom save. On a failure, until its next turn ends it can't take reactions and rolls attacks and ability checks with disadvantage.

name: Stinking Cloud

m.text: Rotten egg or a few skunk cabbage leaves

description: A 20 ft radius sphere of yellow, sickening gas fills a point within 90 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration), spreading around corners; the area is heavily obscured.

Each creature fully inside at the start of its turn makes a Constitution save against poison. On a failure it spends its action that turn retching and reeling. Creatures that needn't breathe or are immune to poison pass automatically.
A moderate wind (10 mph or more) clears it in 4 rounds; a strong wind (20 mph or more) in 1.

name: Stone Shape

m.text: Soft clay, roughly shaped like the result

description: Touch a Medium or smaller stone object, or a piece of stone up to 5 ft in every dimension, and mold it into any shape: a weapon, idol or coffer, a passage through a wall under 5 ft thick, or a sealed-up door.
The result can have at most 2 hinges and a latch; finer moving parts aren't possible.

name: Stoneskin

m.text: Diamond dust worth 100 gp, used up

description: A willing creature you touch gets skin as hard as stone for up to 1 hour (concentration), resisting nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

name: Suggestion

m.text: Snake's tongue plus honeycomb or sweet oil

description: Suggest a reasonable-sounding course of action, in a sentence or two, to a creature you can see within 30 ft that can hear and understand you. Charm-immune creatures are unaffected. Asking for an obviously harmful act ends the spell.
On a failed Wisdom save, it follows the suggestion as best it can for up to 8 hours (concentration), or until the task is done. You can set a trigger; if it never happens, nothing is done.
Damage from you or your companions ends it.

name: Sunbeam

m.text: A magnifying glass

description: For up to 1 minute (concentration) you can fire a 5 ft wide, 60 ft long line of light from your hand: once on casting, then as an action on later turns.
Each creature in the line makes a Constitution save: 6d8 radiant and blinded until your next turn, or half damage and not blinded on a success. Undead and oozes save with disadvantage.
Your hand glows with sunlight meanwhile: bright light to 30 ft, dim light 30 ft further.

name: Swift Quiver

m.text: A quiver holding at least 1 piece of ammunition

description: Your quiver makes endless nonmagical ammunition for up to 1 minute (concentration). Each of your turns, as a bonus action, you can make 2 attacks with a weapon using its ammunition. Each piece fired is replaced.
The made ammunition crumbles when the spell ends. It also ends if the quiver leaves your possession.

name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter

m.text: tiny tarts, a feather

description: A creature you can see within 30 ft, with Intelligence 5 or more, makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it collapses in fits of laughter, prone and incapacitated and unable to stand, for up to 1 minute (concentration).
Each time its turn ends it repeats the save, and it also repeats it (with advantage) whenever it is hurt. Passing ends the spell.

name: Telekinesis
description: For up to 10 minutes (concentration), on casting and as your action each round, you grip one creature or object you can see within 60 ft. Keep the target or switch; the old one is freed.

Creature (Huge or smaller): your spellcasting ability check vs its Strength. Win to move it up to 30 ft any direction within range; it is restrained (and hangs if lifted) until your next turn ends. Win again each round to hold it.
Object (up to 1,000 pounds): unattended, it moves up to 30 ft automatically; worn or carried, win the same contest to pull it away. Fine work, like using a tool or opening a door, is possible.

name: Teleportation Circle

m.text: Rare chalks and gem-infused inks worth 50 gp, used up

description: Draw a 10 ft circle linked to a permanent teleportation circle on your plane whose sigil sequence you know. A portal opens until the end of your next turn; anyone stepping in appears within 5 ft of that circle (or the nearest free space).
You start knowing 2 Material Plane sequences picked by the DM, and can memorize another after 1 minute of study. Casting it in the same spot daily for a year makes a permanent circle.

name: Tenser's Floating Disk

m.text: a drop of mercury

description: A horizontal disk of force, 3 ft across and 1 inch thick, floats 3 ft above the ground in a free space within 30 ft for 1 hour. It holds up to 500 lb; more weight ends the spell and everything drops.
It stays put while you are within 20 ft, and trails you to stay within 20 ft if you move away. It cannot cross a 10 ft height change. If you get more than 100 ft from it, the spell ends. Ritual.

name: Thaumaturgy
description: You show a minor wonder within 30 ft. Choose one:
• Your voice booms up to 3 times louder for 1 minute.
• Flames flicker, brighten, dim or change colour for 1 minute.
• Harmless tremors shake the ground for 1 minute.
• A sound you choose starts at a point you pick.
• An unlocked door or window flies open or slams shut.
• Your eyes change appearance for 1 minute.
Up to 3 of the 1-minute effects at once; dismiss one as an action.

name: Thorn Whip

summary.upcast: 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 11, 4d6 at level 17

m.text: the stem of a plant with thorns

description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature within 30 ft. A hit deals 1d6 piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller you can yank it up to 10 ft closer to you.
Damage rises to 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 11 and 4d6 at level 17.

name: Thunderous Smite
description: Your next melee weapon hit within 1 minute (concentration) rings with a thunderclap audible 300 ft away and deals 2d6 extra thunder damage. The target makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 ft away and knocked prone.

name: Thunderwave
description: A wave of force bursts out from you in a 15 ft cube. Creatures inside roll a Constitution save: failing means 2d8 thunder damage and a 10 ft shove away from you; passing means half damage and no shove.
Loose objects in the cube are pushed 10 ft too, and the boom can be heard 300 ft away.
higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d8 for each slot level above 1.

name: Tongues

m.text: Small clay model of a ziggurat

description: For 1 hour, the creature you touch understands every spoken language it hears, and when it talks, any listener who speaks some language understands it.

name: Transport via Plants
description: Link a Large or larger inanimate plant within 10 ft to another plant anywhere on your plane, one you've seen or touched before.
Until the end of your next turn, any creature can spend 5 ft of movement to step into the first plant and out of the other.

name: Tree Stride
description: For up to 1 minute (concentration), spend 5 ft of movement to enter a living tree at least your size. You sense all trees of that kind within 500 ft and, with the same move, can pass into one or step back out.
You exit within 5 ft of the destination tree for another 5 ft of movement (with none left, you exit by the tree you entered). Once per round; end each turn outside a tree.

name: True Seeing

m.text: Eye ointment of mushroom powder, saffron and fat worth 25 gp, used up

description: A willing creature you touch gains truesight for 1 hour: within 120 ft it sees things as they truly are, notices secret doors hidden by magic, and sees into the Ethereal Plane.

name: True Strike
description: Point at a target within 30 ft. On your next turn, your first attack roll against it has advantage, provided the spell is still going (concentration, 1 round).

name: Unseen Servant

m.text: string, a bit of wood

description: An invisible, mindless, shapeless force appears on the ground within 60 ft for 1 hour. Its AC is 10, it has 1 hit point and Strength 2, and it cannot attack. Reaching 0 hit points ends the spell.

Once per turn, as a bonus action, send it up to 15 ft to interact with an object. It does simple chores (fetching, cleaning, mending, folding, lighting fires, serving food, pouring wine), working a task until done. A task taking it over 60 ft from you ends the spell. Ritual.

name: Vampiric Touch
description: Shadows wreathe your hand for up to 1 minute (concentration). Attack a creature in your reach with a melee spell attack: a hit deals 3d6 necrotic damage, and you heal hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.
On each of your turns while the spell lasts, you can use your action to repeat this attack.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 adds 1d6 damage.

name: Vicious Mockery

summary.upcast: 2d4 at level 5, 3d4 at level 11, 4d4 at level 17

description: You hurl a cutting insult at a creature you can see within 60 ft. If it can hear you (it need not understand), it makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d4 psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
Damage rises to 2d4 at level 5, 3d4 at level 11 and 4d4 at level 17.

name: Wall of Fire

m.text: A small piece of phosphorus

description: An opaque wall of fire stands on a solid surface within 120 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration): up to 60 ft long, 20 ft high and 1 ft thick, or a ring up to 20 ft across, 20 ft high and 1 ft thick.
Creatures in it when it appears make a Dexterity save: 5d8 fire, half on a success.
Choose one side. A creature ending its turn within 10 ft of that side or inside the wall takes 5d8 fire, as does one entering it for the first time on a turn. The other side is harmless.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 4 adds 1d8.

name: Wall of Force

m.text: Powder from a crushed clear gemstone

description: An invisible, 1/4 inch thick wall of force appears within 120 ft for up to 10 minutes (concentration), at any angle, floating or resting. Shape it as a dome or sphere up to 10 ft in radius, or as ten 10 by 10 ft panels, each touching another. Creatures in its path are pushed to a side you pick.
Nothing physical gets through, and it reaches into the Ethereal Plane. It takes no damage and dispel magic doesn't work, but disintegrate destroys it at once.

name: Wall of Ice

m.text: A small piece of quartz

description: A 1 ft thick ice wall forms on a solid surface within 120 ft for up to 10 minutes (concentration): a dome or sphere up to 10 ft in radius, or ten 10 ft square panels, each touching another.
A creature in its space is pushed to one side and makes a Dexterity save: 10d6 cold, half on a success.

Each 10 ft section has AC 12 and 30 HP and is vulnerable to fire. A destroyed section leaves frigid air; crossing it the first time on a turn calls for a Constitution save: 5d6 cold, half on a success.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 6 adds 2d6 to the first blast and 1d6 to the frigid air.

name: Wall of Stone

m.text: A small block of granite

description: A nonmagical stone wall appears within 120 ft for up to 10 minutes (concentration): ten 10 by 10 ft panels 6 inches thick, or 10 by 20 ft panels 3 inches thick, each touching another. It needs no foundation but must join existing stone, so it can bridge gaps or form ramps; spans over 20 ft need half-size panels as supports.
Creatures in its path are pushed aside. One about to be fully enclosed makes a Dexterity save; success lets it use its reaction to move up to its speed out.
Each panel has AC 15 and 30 HP per inch of thickness. If you concentrate the full 10 minutes, it becomes permanent and can't be dispelled.

name: Wall of Thorns

m.text: A handful of thorns

description: A wall of thorny brush grows on a solid surface within 120 ft for up to 10 minutes (concentration), blocking sight: up to 60 ft long, 10 ft high and 5 ft thick, or a ring 20 ft across, up to 20 ft high and 5 ft thick.
Creatures in it when it appears make a Dexterity save: 7d8 piercing, half on a success.
Moving through costs 4 ft per 1 ft. Entering it the first time on a turn or ending a turn there calls for a Dexterity save: 7d8 slashing, half on a success.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 6 adds 1d8 to both kinds of damage.

name: Warding Bond

m.text: 2 platinum rings worth 50 gp each, worn by you and the target

description: You link yourself to a willing creature you touch for 1 hour. While it is within 60 ft of you, it gets +1 to AC and saves and resistance to all damage, but you take the same amount of damage it takes.
It ends if you drop to 0 hit points, you move more than 60 ft apart, either of you is targeted by it again, or you dismiss it as an action.

name: Water Breathing

m.text: Short reed or piece of straw

description: For 24 hours, as many as ten willing creatures you can see within 30 ft can breathe underwater, and still breathe air normally.

name: Water Walk

m.text: Piece of cork

description: For 1 hour, as many as ten willing creatures you can see within 30 ft can walk on any liquid (water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, lava) as if it were harmless solid ground, though lava's heat can still hurt.
A target submerged in liquid rises to the surface at 60 ft per round.

name: Web

m.text: Bit of spiderweb

description: Sticky webs fill a 20 ft cube from a point within 60 ft (difficult terrain, lightly obscured). Unless strung between two solid masses or layered on a surface (5 ft deep), they collapse at the start of your next turn, ending it.
Starting a turn in or entering the webs: Dexterity save or is restrained while there. Escape: action and Strength check vs your spell save DC.
Fire burns a 5 ft cube of web away in a round; creatures starting their turn in that fire take 2d4 fire damage.

name: Wind Walk

m.text: Fire and holy water

description: You and up to 10 willing creatures you can see within 30 ft turn into wisps of cloud for 8 hours: flying speed 300 ft and resistance to damage from nonmagical weapons. In this form the only actions are Dash or changing back.
Switching form either way takes 1 minute, during which the creature is incapacitated and can't move.
If the spell ends while one is flying as a cloud, it sinks 60 ft per round for 1 minute and lands safely; if it hasn't landed by then, it falls the rest of the way.

name: Wind Wall

m.text: Tiny fan and an exotic feather

description: A wall of strong wind, up to 50 ft long, 15 ft high and 1 ft thick, rises at a point within 120 ft, in any shape that follows one unbroken path on the ground. Creatures in it when it appears make a Strength save, taking 3d8 bludgeoning damage, half on a success.

It blocks fog, smoke and gases. Small or smaller flyers and objects, and gaseous creatures, can't cross. Ordinary arrows, bolts and other missiles fired through it automatically miss (boulders and siege ammo don't).

name: Witch Bolt

m.text: twig from a lightning-struck tree

description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 30 ft. A hit deals 1d12 lightning damage and links you to the target with a beam for up to 1 minute (concentration).

On each later turn you can use your action to zap it for 1d12 lightning damage with no roll. The link breaks if you use your action on anything else, or if the target ends up out of range or behind full cover.
higherLevels: The first hit's damage rises by 1d12 for each slot level above 1.

name: Word of Recall
description: You and up to 5 willing creatures within 5 ft teleport to your prepared sanctuary, arriving in the nearest free spaces to the spot you chose.
Prepare a sanctuary by casting this spell in a place dedicated to or tied to your deity, such as a temple. Cast anywhere else, or without a sanctuary, it does nothing.

name: Wrathful Smite
description: Your next melee weapon hit within 1 minute (concentration) adds 1d6 psychic damage. The target also makes a Wisdom save or becomes frightened of you for the rest of the spell.
Once frightened, it can spend an action on a Wisdom check, trying to beat your spell save DC. Success ends the spell.

name: Zone of Truth
description: For 10 minutes, a 15 ft radius sphere on a point within 60 ft guards against lies. A creature entering it for the first time on a turn, or starting its turn there, makes a Charisma save; on a failure it can't deliberately lie while inside. You know who passed and who failed.
Affected creatures know about the spell, so they can dodge questions or give evasive but truthful answers.
